pages.h:
As an Aerial Firefighter, you will be navigating the skies responding to and putting out large fires all over the map to get rewarded with Money, Firefighter & Airline EXP as well with EXP Tokens.

Getting Started

1. Go to the Specialized Job marker Specialized Job(12/-) at the LSIA Fire Department / Crash Team Building. (Shown in the following picture)

2. Go to the orange Job Selector circle and choose Aerial Firefighter.

3. To buy your water bomber, you will need to visit any Aircraft Dealership Aircraft Shop.

4. Go to any Aircraft Garage Aircraft Garage and spawn your water bomber.

5. Remain on standby until an assignment is given to you.

6. You will receive an assignment with a region attached. Fly to the area, on the map you can find the fire marked with Fire and an orange circle on the ground.

7. To put out the fire, open the water bays using “Space” and fly over the fires. Once you put out all the fires you will receive payment.

8. Wait for another assignment and repeat!

You’ll likely be out of water very quickly, you can either land on the water with the water bay open if your water bomber is capable to refill, or you can land at any airport and park on the Re-fill Zone Refill Zone

pages.h:
Airline PilotAirline emoji is one of the jobs (and skills) available in Transport Tycoon. As an airplane pilot you will transport passengers with airplanes between various airports using Air Traffic Control (ATC). You will have to start off with a small airplane and gradually work your way up to take control of huge airliners. Like any tiered job, your pay will depend heavily on your progress within the skill.

Getting Started

Airplanes are expensive, so consider doing another job first such as Garbage Collector, Train Conductor or take a Loan. If airports are not loading while flying then enable Settings → Advanced Graphics → High Detail Streaming While Flying.

  1. To begin this job, as with most other jobs, you need to visit a Job CenterJob Center job center or have the appropriate job card and change your job to Airline Pilot.
  2. To buy your first plane you will need to visit the LSIA Aircraft Dealership Aircraft Shop Aircraft Shop, located on the north-western side of the airport behind the Los Santos Customs.
  3. Once you have bought your plane, spawn it at the Aircraft Garage Aircraft Garage and taxi to a terminal Terminal terminal. At the terminal, you will be prompted to press "E" to let your passengers board the plane. Make sure to not drift outside of the boarding zone or you will be punished with a 10-minute cooldown.
  4. After all the passengers have boarded you will now see a lighter terminal Terminal Destination terminal destination icon. Fly to that airport (you can use ATC for extra experience) and deboard your passengers at the marked gate. After your passengers have been deboarded successfully, you will be rewarded with money and EXP Tokens, it will then automatically board new passengers that need to be transported to another airport.

Job Bonuses

Meals

To earn further Airline Experience and money from this job you may carry either Airline Meals or Complete Meals with you which will boost the rewards you receive from this job! In order to make Airline Meals, you must do Refrigerated Trucking in combination with either Fishing or Hunting to get Meat. Complete Meals can also serve as an alternative and they can be crafted in a player's home with components gathered from breaking down food in your inventory. Do note that while Complete Meals do function in the same way, they provide a much smaller bonus compared to Airline Meals.

Air Traffic Control (ATC)

For the Airline Pilot job, correct usage of the Air Traffic Control system will reward the player with extra Experience on correct takeoffs and landings. Incorrect usage will result in a Runway Utilization Detection System (RUDS) violation. This applies a temporary 15 minute penalty resulting in a reduction to the money and Experience received when dropping off passengers.

Airports

You can refer to the following map for an overview of all airports with their identification codes and MAIN, SIDE and JET runways.

Transport Tycoon API

The api for TT follows a few standard principles:

  • Certain routes will return different data based on server
  • Every server requires a different URL to fetch data from, instead of one standardized URL
  • Legacy routes use the /status path in urls. v1.api.tycoon addresses are automatically routed with /status.

Available servers

[LITE] Transportation

Runs a different gamemode, does not respond to standard Transport Tycoon API calls. sessionmanager/players.json will fetch a list of players.

Server list CDN file

Tycoon's CDN hosts a permanent JSON file that returns a list of servers, their player information endpoint, and a template for formatting API URL calls to each server. In addition to the main Transport Tycoon servers, it also includes information for the [LITE] Transportation server. The file is available at https://cdn.tycoon.community/servers.json.

Private Keys

TL;DR: Create a new private key using /api private new

Check your charges by typing /api private charges

Add charges using /api private refill (adds 1000 charges for $1M)

Add x charges using /api private refill (adds charges for $1000 * x)

The API requires a private key to access most features.

Each private key has a limited amount of API calls (also called charges), which are consumed every time an API call is made using the key. Additional charges can be purchased in game using the /api private refill command at the cost of $1000 (in-game money) per charge. Any user can generate a private key (Make sure you keep it safe). To generate a private key, use the /api private new command in game. If you already have a private key generated, the old one will be deleted and a new one will take its place. When you generate a private key for the first time, it will come with some free charges allowing you to test the API for free. The API key can be copied using the /api private copy command, which will display the key for you to copy to your clipboard. Any user with a linked Discord account will receive a Discord role upon refilling their keys.

Donating API charges

When using services created by other players, they usually use their own private key. If you wish to support them, you can donate charges to them with /api donate

where
is the ID of the player whose key is being used for a given service
is the amount of charges you want to donate (each charge is $1000).
The minimum amount of charges you can donate is 1000.

If the receiving player is online and in the same server as you, they will get a notification of receipt.

Public Keys

Public keys are keys that can be used to access a players account information without needing that player's private key and charges.

The public key is not valid by itself and must be included alongside a valid private key

The public key can be be used as an authorization/identification token, changing the target account from the private key's owner to the public key's owner for commands whose data is determined by public/private key ownership (i.e deadliest_catch, faction endpoints) or, allowing access to data for accounts with API locks in place.

To generate a public key, use /api public generate

Privacy related options

You may restrict access to your own data with the /api lock command in-game. When your API information is locked, data is inaccessible to anyone requesting it unless the request includes your public or private key.

API Endpoints

General notes

  • Private keys should be sent as headers, like such: X-Tycoon-Key: [api-key]
  • Public keys are sent with the X-Tycoon-Public-Key: [public-key] header
  • Each endpoint here will mention if a private key is required to be used. Note that currently, every route which requires a key will only use 1 charge per request.
  • Typically, this data is returned as JSON, unless explicitly mentioned.
  • Most routes will have a response header called X-Tycoon-Charges, which will give you the number of private key charges remaining after the request.

Standard status codes

  • 400 Bad Request - invalid endpoint
  • 401 Unauthorized - A private key is required for the route
  • 402 Payment Required - No API charges remaining
  • 403 Forbidden - Invalid private key or invalid public key
  • 404 Not Found - Invalid API route

pages.h:
An ATM ATM allows you to withdraw and deposit cash with the Maze Bank. ATM's can be found all over the map.

There are several ways to reach an ATM:

  • At Public ATM locations
  • At purchasable businesses locations
  • A Portable ATM Phone Extension (Requires Premium)
  • At a Faction ATM

Purpose of ATM's and Banks

There is currently no reason to store your cash in a bank, but who walks around the street with billions in pocket change?

Previously, the ATM's were used to create gift cards. They were used to avoid tax, as giving cash money to people used to be taxed. As of the Changelogs of 20 February 2021, This is no longer the case, and gift cards can not be made anymore.

Auto Focus (or Auto-Focus) refers to a chat function that allows the player to make the chat disappear, not reappearing for every message that is received.

To enable Auto Focus: press CTRL+T, click on Auto-Focus to hide the chat (it should turn red), then close the chat and wait. The chat will fade away in a few seconds.
The button is a toggle, so pressing Auto-Focus again makes the chat pop up as usual.

pages.h:
You can only have one owned vehicle (per general category) out at a given time. If you wish to spawn another owned vehicle, you will need to park your vehicle first. There are four methods of parking.

In order to park your vehicle, you will either need to be in or right next to the vehicle. In case your vehicle is far away, try to locate it with the map legend. Look for the 'Personal Vehicle' blip and place a waypoint.

B ► Auto-Park

By holding the B button (keyboard), a radial menu will show up. In that menu, click on Auto-Park. Confirm by pressing F5 and your owned vehicle will despawn.

M ► Car / Options ► Autopark (Delete)

Navigate via the M menu, M ► Car / Options ► Autopark (Delete). Confirm by pressing F5 and your owned vehicle will despawn.

M ► Zdelete

Navigate via the M menu, M ► Zdelete

This option only shows up if you are not inside a vehicle. For big vehicles, such as airplanes, you'll have to run around (and under) the vehicle and spam Zdelete until the vehicle despawns. This option is useful for cleaning up abandoned vehicles, as you can Zdelete other players' and NPC vehicles.

Parking inside a Garage Marker

Move your vehicle inside of a garage marker and look at the context menu in the bottom right. This will show what key combination you need to press in order to park the vehicle. By default, on keyboard, this is (hold) Spacebar + press C.

Notes

Beach Clean Up Beach Clean Up is one of the Specialized Jobs that is available within Transport Tycoon Tycoon . As a beach cleaner you will clean the beaches of Vespucci Beach, gathering sand and trash in the meantime.

The sand can be used for Trucking, the trash can be saved up to make Treasure Chests at the Recycling Plant Recycling Plant in the Grand Senora Desert.

Getting Started

  • Go to the Specialized Job marker Specialized Job near the Del Perro Pier at the lifeguard station.

-1482.6 -1030.1 Specialized Job.png IfYouSeeThisYouLostTheGame
  • Go to the orange job selector circle and choose Beach Clean Up.
  • Go to the blue circle and Go on Duty.
  • You should see a question mark on your map.
    • This is where you spawn your beach clean up vehicle. Spawn the appropriate vehicle for your Garbage level.
  • You should see three sand excavation zones Excavation Zone 24 along the beach. Once you enter these very large blue circles, you will start to gain Garbage Collector experience, sand, and trash as you drive your beach clean up vehicle in the circle.
  •  Occasionally you will see red circles inside the big blue area. If you drive through them, you will receive a bonus!

  • Since the nearby job center marker also includes the Trucking job, you can bring a trailer and place it nearby to be able to store your sand for transporting in bulk.
    • This job is a good alternative for gathering sand if you're not fond of the Quarry Rubble Route.
  • It is also a good method of leveling up your garbage skill if you’re not a fan of the Garbage routes, a bonus of doing it this way is that you will accumulate Sand which can be sold to other players or used to make concrete or other goods.

pages.h:
Binding, what's that?

Binding is a process of connecting a KEY (keyboard / mouse / pad) with various functions (Commands). Mostly used to ease, improve and speed up various processes on the Transport Tycoon servers. It can be used to bind standard chat commands such as /help, but it can also be used in more advanced ways like to bind items and vRP functions.

How to bind?

Certain Transport Tycoon related binds are also available in your GTA settings: P (or ESC key) → Settings → Key Bindings → FiveM.

reminder

Press F8 - the ingame console should open - then fill in the bind template given below depending on your need and paste it in the console.

To bind something to a KEY

  • bind KEY_TYPE KEY "FUNCTION OPTION MODIFIER"

To unbind a KEY

  • unbind KEY_TYPE KEY

List of all binded KEYs (works only on a canary build of FiveM)

  • bind

List of binds can also be accessed in %appdata%/CitizenFX in the file named fivem.cfg

info


Disclaimer: To bind multiple functions on one KEY do it all at once using ; between binds, ALSO remember to unbind your bind before binding other commands to the same KEY otherwise you might get flagged for flooding and get kicked / suspended!!! Also try not to hold/spam the bounded KEY as you also might get kicked for that.

warn

Example: bind keyboard k "rm_backpack;item gut_knife gut -1"

info

KEY_TYPE & KEY

KEY_TYPE is a parameter describing input devices, such as a keyboard (KEYBOARD), mouse buttons (MOUSE_BUTTON), or mouse wheel (MOUSE_WHEEL).
KEY is an parameter for a key. Numbers (1,2,3...) and letters (a,b,c...) can be used by just pressing your wanted KEY, but for majority of keys their full name needs to be entered, for example: , = COMMA; = = EQUALS; / = SLASH; left click = MOUSE_LEFT.
Refer to FiveM Docs for full list of KEY_TYPEs & KEYs

Do not open FiveM Docs page in-game!

warn

FUNCTION

Enter your wanted function here, keep in mind that function is a command so any ingame command can be used here, for more info refer to Bind Data Table/Functions or Commands Page.
Remember to use " " when using more than one word in a bind!

OPTION

Option is used with /item command such as "item gut_knife gut" or "item prefix_pack_3 use" as a parameter deciding what an item will do.
Refer to Bind Data Table for a list of all options and their description or to check which item has which options.

MODIFIER

Mostly used with /item command, simulates the press of a button. -1 is Left Arrow; 0 or none is Enter; 1 is Right Arrow.

Bind Data Table

Binds

Examples


Perfect bind for Airline Pilots Converts all airline & player tokens into BXP after pressing F2

bind keyboard F2 "item exp_tokenpilotingpiloting convert -1;item exp_tokenplayerplayer convert -1"

info


Convert one Gambling Token into Bonus EXP after pressing F1 on keyboard, no modifier means simulating Enter (option 1x):

bind keyboard F1 "item exp_tokencasinocasino convert"

info


Use rotten potato's freecam feature by pressing F2

bind keyboard F2 "item rotten_potato freecam"

info


Changes current job into a Mechanic after pressing . (DECIMAL) on numpad:

bind keyboard DECIMAL "item job_cardmechanic become"

info


Re-opens transformer after pressing L on keyboard:

bind keyboard L "vrp-reopen"

info


Guts all fishes in player's inventory after pressing = (EQUALS) on keyboard:

bind keyboard EQUALS "item gut_knife gut"

info


Opens faction menu after pressing mouse button 4:

bind mouse_button MOUSE_EXTRABTN2 "faction"

info


Converts all EXP Tokens into Bonus EXP after pressing K on keyboard:

Read before binding

This option is also available through the custom FiveM Keybinds. Navigate there via P (or ESC key) → Settings → Key Bindings → FiveM

bind keyboard K "item exp_token convert -1 all"

Blessings

Blessings (also known as Chat Prefix Icons) are emotes that can be placed in front of your name in the in-game chat. They are obtained from opening Blessing Packs, which can be purchased in game at the Market(Premium/VIP).

Using and setting a blessing

You can open a Blessing Pack in your inventory by selecting the pack and hitting "Use." A random Blessing from the series will then appear in your inventory, which you can then either sell to other players or Use to put its icon into your Chat Prefix Icon list. Opening more than one blessing pack will require you to purchase and use a Cursed Dice from the Market(Premium/VIP) first.

To open the Chat Prefix Icon list and set the prefix icon you obtained from a blessing, navigate to
M -> Player Options -> Change Chat Appearance -> Change Chat Prefix Icon.

This page is about Bouncers Trucking Calculator, for his userpage, see User:Bouncer

Bouncers Trucking Calculator is a versatile tool that allows you to easily visualize the process of creating trucking items. The calculator can be accessed by clicking here. Alternatively refer to the Quick Presets below for ease-of-access links that can be used in the in-game F7 browser. Be aware of the Restrictions.

Quick Presets

  • Premium with 30 Strength and MK14
    • ↑+ Quick link to settings page
    • ↑+ Activated Strength Perk
    • ↑+ Activated PostOP Perk
  • No premium with 1 strength and MK1, opens on Settings page

Setup Video Guide

To translate the video start subtitles click on auto subtitles in EN then click subtitles again and select your language. <evlplayer id="player1" alignment="center" w="1200" h="300" service="youtube" defaultid="M19xbk1WeQE" description="Video made by community member catosaur explaining the settings page, going into detail on how to set up the API"/>

Restrictions

If your Strength is above level 30, ensure you still set up your Strength level as 30. Any level above 30 Strength does not give extra inventory space but the calculator will still add extra space that you do not have. If you wish to not use your inventory at all during your trucking, set your strength as 0 in the calculator. This way it will not consider your inventory for the trip calculations.

Due to the in-game browser not storing any information, you will have to refill in your alternative recipes, API key and UserID in the settings every time if you wish to use those features with the in-game browser.

The in-game browsers' size is rather small, in some instances you'll have to scroll to the left of right. To more easily do this, hold LeftShift while moving the scroll wheel up or down to move left or right respectively.

About

The Bouncers Trucking Calculator was created by Bouncer for the FiveM Transport Tycoon server. It is based on a calculator for Satisfactory by Kirk McDonald.

The map was created by Nova+ using Leaflet, a JS library for interactive maps, (c) 2010-2019 Vladimir Agafonkin, (c) 2010-2011 CloudMade. Leaflet.ContinuousZoom.js - Written by Ilya Zverev, licensed WTFPL.

Most emojis are designed by OpenMoji – the open-source emoji and icon project. License: CC BY-SA 4.0.

Data provided by glitchdetector

The source code can be found at https://github.com/bouncer/trucking-calculator. This project is licensed under the Apache License 2.0.

Please report any issues to Bouncer on Discord.

The Bus Driver Bus emoji job (and skill) is a small and calm job. You transport passengers anywhere and everywhere, depending on the level of your bus. It is an easy job for new players in Transport Tycoon!

Getting Started

  1. Go to the Job Center Job Center and choose the bus driver job.
  2. Buy a bus from the Car Dealership Car Dealer.
  3. Drive to one of the bus stations Bus Icon.
  4. At the bus station, there you can start a route with your bus.
  5. Stop at the locations on your map, follow the line on your map for the correct stations Bus Stop and wait for passengers to get in and out.
  6. You get paid during, and at the end of your route.

If you can not afford to buy a bus, find one on the street, at the bus station, near LSIA or ask someone to borrow their bus!

reminder

The number of stops on your route determines how much XP you get at the end of your route. Money is still different and depends on the number of stops you have on the route, but two things are for sure, the higher level your bus is, the more money, EXP, and EXP Tokens you will earn

Not every bus can do every route, for example, due to low roofs.

Businesses Business Saleare places for you to invest your wealth to get a return in profits over a period of time.

Bonuses

Businesses Business generate a bonus that can be picked up every 3 hours until their maximum capacity at 16 stacks. This takes 48 hours of real-life time in total. It is recommended to claim before reaching 16 stacks, as once it reaches 16 stacks it will stop generating extra money. If you buy an "Extra Business Day" through the Tebex Shop, you can receive another 24 hour period to obtain Business Cash Stacks, making your new maximum 24 stacks. This can be bought multiple times to stack more and more possible vacant days before it caps out.

You can find the bonuses on the map indicated by a yellow Dollar sign Business Bonus, indicating the business has at least one bonus ready for collecting, or a blue Dollar sign Business Full, indicating that the business has reached maxed stacks and will not generate any more bonuses. Every bonus has a chance to give a little bit of extra cash stacks on pickup. Experience from Business bonuses does not stack, if you wish to optimize leveling, you should go collect the bonus every 3 hours. This can become tedious when many businesses are owned, which is why using a Business Bonus Collector will be useful.

Business Cash Stacks

Collecting the bonuses from your Businesses gives an item called "Business Cash Stacks". These items are worth 1000$ each and will be redeemed upon gaining experience in any job other than business. They are redeemed in the ratio of 50K Dollars per 1 XP at level 1 business, and 150k dollars per 1 XP at level 100 business. The ratio also changes throughout the different business levels.

Business Bonus Collector

The Train Yards and Ship Yard Business Bonus cannot be collected manually. They can only be collected via a Bonus CollectorBusiness Bonus Collector. This requires either the purchase of the Pacific Standard Bank or requires joining a faction that has acquired the Collector Perk. Players that own the Pacific Standard Bank will be taxed at 20% for using the collector. Players without the bank will be taxed at 30%.

Getting Started

To start investing into businesses, head to Wenger Institute next to the City Hall to buy your first business for $15k.

To unlock different businesses, you will need to level up your Businesses skill level - it can be done via collecting business cash stacks or by doing the RTS or CollinsCo Cabbies job. Business level requirement for specific businesses can be viewed by hovering and clicking over the business that is shown on your map.
Keep in mind that EXP doesn't stack at the collector, so try to collect it as often as you can.

Train yards have linked storages - You can access that storage from any of the other Trainyards that you own.

Earning Business Experience

Besides claiming your business bonuses, you can also earn small amounts of experience in the business skill from the following activities:

  • Delivering vehicles via RTS
  • Transporting passengers as a CollinsCo Cabbie

Purchasable Businesses

For more detailed business spreadsheets, head to Transport Tycoon Discord and check out the #tycoon-spreadsheets channel.

Cargo pilotCargo emoji is one of the jobs (and skills) available in Transport Tycoon. As a cargo pilot you will transport cargo with airplanes between various airports using Air Traffic Control (ATC). You will have to start off with a small airplane and gradually work your way up to take control of huge airliners. Like any tiered job, your pay will depend heavily on your progress within the skill.

Getting Started

Airplanes are expensive, so consider doing another job first such as Garbage Collector or take a Loan. Cargo will eventually deplete in high-demand areas, meaning that longer routes are more sustainable. Delivering and Taking cargo depletes stocks. If airports are not loading while flying then enable Settings → Advanced Graphics → High Detail Streaming While Flying.

  1. Visit any Job CenterJob Center job center (except for Life Invader) or have the appropriate job card and change your job to Cargo Pilot.
  2. To buy your first plane, you will need to visit the Aircraft Dealership Aircraft Shop, located on the north-western side of the airport behind the Los Santos Customs LS Customs (You MUST use a cargo-specific aircraft for this job, no exceptions. You will also be required to have Strength level 8 to carry the cargo).
  3. Once you have bought your plane you will need to taxi to a yellow crate Air Cargo, a menu on the right side of the screen should pop up, if not, try to position yourself differently, so that the plane icon overlaps the crate icon on your minimap.
  4. Purchase some cargo of your choice (Based on levels & stocks), It will display the airport it can be taken to, these airports will give you the reward.
    • Make sure to also fill up the Trunk of the cargo plane you are using!
  5. Unlike Airline piloting, your destination is not shown on your minimap, so if you don't know where the airport you're flying to is located, be sure to open your map before takeoff and mark it by double-clicking on the yellow crateAir Cargo at the destination airport. A map of all airports can be seen below.
  6. Once you have delivered the Cargo, you will be rewarded with money and EXP.

Job Bonuses

For the Cargo Pilot job, correct usage of the Air Traffic Control system will reward the player with extra Experience on correct takeoffs and landings. Incorrect usage will result in a Runway Utilization Detection System (RUDS) violation. This applies a temporary 15 minute penalty resulting in only being able to choose the x1 pickup and delivery options.

🌴 Cayo Perico 🌴 is an Island, where you can do multiple <a data-p

"Job Center">jobs, do certain hidden activities to obtain unique vehicle spawn cards and even buy the EL Rubio's Compound (Business).

Cayo Perico Island

The Island is located Southeast (SE) <img src

"https://dash.tycoon.community/wiki/images/b/be/Southeast.png" alt="Southeast.png"> of San Andreas.

reminder

Map of the Island, including perks from the Business.

Jobs

The Island offers few different jobs at the Job Center Job Center.

Airline Pilot

Airline PilotAirline emoji is one of the jobs (and skills) available in Transport Tycoon. As an airline pilot, you will transport passengers to and from various airports. You will have to start off with a small plane and gradually work your way up to take control of huge airliners. Like any tiered job, your pay will depend heavily on your progress within the skill.

Cargo Pilot

Cargo PilotCargo emoji is one of the jobs (and skills) available in Transport Tycoon. As a cargo pilot, you will transport goods to and from various airports. You will have to start off with a small plane and gradually work your way up to take control of huge cargo planes. Like any tiered job, your pay will depend heavily on your progress within the skill.

Hunter

The HunterHunting emoji is usually regarded as a good and entertaining way to make money when you start, however, it’s wise to first follow the Getting Started Guide or work as Garbage Collector to increase strength and inventory space first. If you like sniper rifles and sniping pixelated animals, this job is for you. Watch out for dangerous kitties and deer-looking bears!

*lvl 25 Hunting required to start hunting in the Cayo Perico Pest Patrol zone.

Fisher

FishingFishing emoji is a calming job that takes you away from the hustle and bustle that is the Tycoon life. It lets you have thoughts about your next adventure or next lavish vehicle purchase and earn money while doing it! Does anyone smell fish?

Leisure Pilot

Being a Leisure or "Recreational" Pilot is a job where you can use your suited aircraft to fly around the map. (Doesn't give any exp.)

Street Racer

As a Street RacerRacing emoji, you can compete against other players times on community-made racecourses. There are even races on the Island!

Hidden Activities

You can do 6 different activities to get rewarded with special vehicle spawn cards and go up on the leaderboard to show, who's the best!

  1. Spawner in the shed at the Airport.
  2. Spawner East of the Main Dock, close to the watch tower.
  • When you approach the spawner close enough, it will be visible on the map with the Hidden icon.

How to start?

  • When you arrive to Cayo Perico Airport, go the shed which is close to it and spawn the Dinka Verus.
  • Now go to the closest Warehouse Warehouse and pick up the ammunition.
  • You can start re-stocking the weapon stashes Weapon Stash with it until you're done, in the meantime you can do the other activities which are visible above. ⬆
  • If you have finished the re-stocking, you can now find the Brute Lavoro spawner between the East of the Main Docks and the Watch Tower.
  • Again, go to the closest Warehouse Warehouse and deliver the cargo to the delivery location. Cargo Delivery

Rewards for finishing the activities

- Unique Vehicle Spawn Cards

To stay up-to-date, check out our #changelogfx channel on the Transport Tycoon Discord.

Dates are the days each update was announced in #changelogfx. Newest first.

August 13th 2026

August 13th Server Update

Daily / Weekly Challenges

  • Introducing daily and weekly challenges!
  • Each player receives their own set of challenges to complete.
  • Completing challenges rewards you with EXP Bonuses you can redeem.
  • Challenges can be viewed via /challenges and M > Identity > Challenges

Roxwood

  • Updated Roxwood to the latest version
  • Added a new area near Lombart Bay
  • Added some new POIs

Concrete Delivery

  • Added the Concrete Delivery specialized job
  • The job is a simple A-B delivery mission
  • Serves as a current measure to slow down House crafting rewards

EMS

  • The EMS Perk now gives you Pills in your paycheck
  • Tweaked the reward bonus from streaks (Smoother curve, higher mid-reward, lower end-reward)
  • Co-drivers now receive a small reward
  • Mobile ER drivers now receive a substantial reward

Conductor

  • Train Conductor jobs now give a reward bonus for their streaks

Helicopter Pilot

  • Helicopter Pilot now receive bonuses based on the streak

Spaceship Parts (EXP Boost)

  • Changed spawning logic so boosts dont vanish in places like Roxwood
  • Added multiple informants, one in Marina Beach, one between Sandy Shores and Grapeseed and the original near City Hall
  • Informants now mark the general area on the map making locating their intel easier

Server

  • Fixed an error when loading new users
  • Added user stats for lots of activities and interactions (for challenges)
  • Fixed player and server counts for Discord and economy.csv
  • Credits page can now show photos from resources
  • Fixed username fetching from the DB
  • Re-enabled the Backpack shortcut bind
  • Expanded the table helper library
  • M > Identity now supports a sub-menu where some information has been moved to

July 2nd 2026

A small patch with some features from beta, mainly bugfixes and backend changes.

Helicopter Pilot

  • Streak rewards have been adjusted to be more generous
  • Streak bonus is now given for each stop, not just the end of the route

Bus Driver

  • Added the Vulcar Bridgestrike, a new double-decker bus on-par with the existing double-decker
  • Added the Articulated Bus as a bonus tier 4 job vehicle, it can be spawned in Juniper by the Shore and near the Market Station in Davis/Strawberry.

Businesses

  • "Free Business" cards now turn into Business Cash Stacks

This happens automatically when they enter your inventory. Any that are in your inventory can be put into a storage and taken back out to convert them. The amount of cash stacks given is equal to the value of the card. The items have been given new names and descriptions aswell.

Self Storages

  • Covered some edge cases during transfers that lead to items vanishing

Server

  • NUI callbacks now have an origin check
  • Re-configured some API calls to a new domain

June 10th 2026

This update consists of bugfixes and some additions to jobs.

Thank you to ArtemOP for providing code fixes and additions, and to Morfik for helping with new EXP Boost locations.

Plus a special thanks to everyone who provided beta feedback, bug reports and suggestions!

Perks

  • Business Perk
    • "Spawn Jet-ski" now spawns a Ricochet when not in water

Los Santos Customs

  • Added new wheel categories
    • Benny's Originals
    • Benny's Bespoke
    • Open Wheel
    • Street wheels
    • Track wheels
  • Interior Color
    • Added the option to choose an Interior Color
  • Fender
    • A category of Fender options was missing, these now show in the existing Fender menu

Bugfixes

  • Forklift Certified is now awarded when reaching 100 missions (was 101)
  • Spaceship Parts no longer show while in the flying broom
  • (Hopefully) disabled spawning of crop dusters
  • You can no longer purchase additional faction capcacity past the limit
  • You can no longer consume more treasure keys than you have chests

Jobs

  • CollinsCo Cabbie
    • Added M-menu option to go on duty as CollinsCo Cabbie
    • Prevent race condition error in Cabbie job (This sometimes pulled animals into vehicles)
  • Bus Driver
    • Moved some bugged stops on the Behemoth routes for Bus Driver
    • Fixed Bus Driver routes that were broken
    • Re-routed some of the stops on those routes too
    • Added a bus-stop (and related) pack
    • This adds bus stops, bus shelters and other decorations all over San Andreas
    • The Bus and Airport Bus now feature dynamic route text (only you see this)
  • Trucker
    • Fixed the Tools Seller not marking the next location on your radar
    • Corrected the Roxwood Intl. Raceway location's job requirement
    • Corrected trucking level requirement to drive the Voyager Box SWB
  • Firefighter
    • Water contents in your vehicle now persists between missions
  • Helicopter Pilot
    • Added rewards based on your streak
    • Your current streak is now displayed correctly
  • Airline Pilot
    • Added rewards based on your streak
    • Your current streak is now displayed correctly
  • PIGS
    • Slightly moved the job selector
  • RTS
    • Added missing map icons for Roxwood locations
    • Remove APC and prox mines from Medved to stop screen flickering during RTS deliveries

Phone

  • Mobile Job Center
    • Added CollinsCo Cabbies at Racing 100
    • Added RTS Transporter at Racing 100
    • Added RTS Aviator at Airline Piloting 100
    • Added RTS Professional at Racing & Airline Pilot 100

Vehicles

  • Added custom classes to a bunch of vehicles (Mostly trucks, semi-cabs and some emergency models)
  • Added a warning message when the anti-wiggle triggers in semi-cabs
  • Added 6 missing EVs to the electric list
  • Locking player owned vehicles now blocks other players from entering them.

Hey! Here's a quick rundown of the new changes on the server:

Factions

  • Removed the "Leave Faction" button in the President Menu.
  • Faction President can now kick themselves via the member management screen instead.
  • Enabled the Public Listing system.
  • Implemented a capacity system.
  • All factions have a capacity of 50 members by default.
  • Faction President can expand the member capacity by 50 members for 1 billion faction credits.
  • Faction capacity cannot exceed 500 members.
  • Improved public list to only contain factions that are not full and can afford to onboard new members.
  • Players cannot join full factions, even when manually invited.
  • Added the option to set a Webhook URL where faction logs are sent.
  • Webhooks receive events such as new members, members leaving, perk purchases and more.
  • Members already in a faction are not affected by the capacity, although new members cannot join, and members cannot re-join if the faction is full.
  • Joining a faction via public listing costs the faction credits, if the faction cannot afford the entry cost the faction will no longer appear in the list.

ATC / Runway Utilization Detection System (RUDS)

  • We have implemented a new system, the Runway Utilization Detection System (RUDS)
  • The goal of RUDS is to ensure players utilize the air infrastrucure we have properly.
  • RUDS is integrated with the ATC system and will reward/penalize players depending on their flight performance.
  • Landing or taking off without ATC clearance counts as a RUDS violation
  • Landing or taking off anywhere that is not a marked runway counts as a RUDS violation
  • Proper (clean) takeoff manouvers are rewarded based on your current job and level
  • Proper (clean) landing manouvers are rewarded based on your current job and level
  • Cargo Pilot pickup and dropoff is restricted while you have an active violation
  • Airline Pilot rewards are lowered if you violate RUDS during your mission
  • VTOL aircraft, seaplanes and some special aircraft may be exempt from getting violations due to their different landing and takeoff behaviors

Chat Titles

Chat titles are an addition next to the player's name, that allows them to stand out in the in-game chat.
At the same time, they can show what they own or have accomplished.


There are different types of chat titles, such as:

  • 1 Million Experience Titles.
    • These titles are the most difficult to obtain- usually requiring the second most time & knowledge about the game from a player.
  • 10 Million Experience Titles.
    • You can only obtain these titles if you reach 10 million exp in a certain skill, requiring an insane amount of dedication.
  • Event Titles.
    • Event titles are typically achievable only during special occasional/seasonal events which happen on the Tycoon servers.
    • You can obtain these titles at the end of the event, more information is usually shared during such event.
    • Some of them may be tradable with players.
  • Server / Captain's Hour - Supporter Titles.
    • You can support the Tycoon Developers to keep the server up or support the Captain's Hour Host by buying different goods from the Tebex /shop.
    • Additionally, you can check out the #info channel on the Tycoon Gaming Discord for the Patreon link or press here, where you can find more supporter roles.
  • Total Days Logged In Titles.
    • These titles are awarded for reaching specific total logged-in days.
  • Special / Unique / Other Titles.
    • These kinds of titles are difficult to obtain, unobtainable, or just very rare.
    • Verified roles are usually given by the Devs to the members of the community who are advertising/creating Transport Tycoon related content.
    • This can be done by sharing content on different social media platforms or by streaming gameplay on Twitch, YouTube, etc.
    • In this table, you can also find chat titles that don't fit into other categories.
  • Company Titles.
    • When Companies still existed, you were able to use their titles, starting with only one.
    • After some time, when you ranked up / rose in the company hierarchy, you would have the option to use other titles from the respective company.

To switch chat titles, go to M → Player Options → Change Chat Appearance → Change Chat Title.

Santa will occationally Request certain items at Legion Square, in return for delivering them Santa will give you a present which you can open.

Golden Gun Bakery

The Golden Gun Bakery is Located in Paleto Bay and is used to bake cookies. To Bake 13 Cookies you will need 5 Sugar, 1 Flour and 1 Egg.

  • You can obtain Sugar by Farming and planting Sugar Cane Seeds which are obtained through chests or the Famers Market
  • You can obtain Flour by Farming and planting Wheat Seeds which are obtained through chests or other Players
  • You can obtain 'Eggs by Farming and collecting them from the chickens (100 Per Day During Event)

Snow Plowing

To Start Snow Plowing head to one of the 3 spawn locations.

  • Location 1 - Paleto Bay
  • Location 2 - Grand Senora Desert (Near Filtering Plant)
  • Location 3 - Autopia Pkwy (Near Airport)
  • Once you have obtained a Snow Plow head on the road and ensure you have began salting the roads to Earn Money and Candy Canes.
  • When snowplowing you will slowly lose salt that you can refill at locations around the map to continue earning rewards.

Caroling

Between the hours of 8 PM and 6 AM (in-game) you can go to doors and press E to Carol at houses. Each door will give candy canes on a successful completion of the Quick Time Event. The best area is Grove Street and Appartments nearby that area. Mirror Park is also a good area.

Doors can only be Caroled once per night, no need to relog to go Caroling again just wait for 8pm again!

Courier

This can be done by delivering presents around los santos and receiving Candy Canes for each delivery More information can be found about the Courier Job in Courier

The Clothing Store Clothing Store is the place where you can customize your character's appearance or choose between a variety of models from different kinds of work clothing & pedestrian outfits.

  • There are a total of 19 Clothing stores around the map.
  • Once you are done customizing your character, you can save your outfit by going to: M → Player Options → Wardrobe → Save.
  • To delete an outfit from the Wardrobe menu, highlight the outfit that you have previously saved then press Left Arrow key to delete it.
  • There's no limit to how many outfits you can store in your Wardrobe.

Keep in mind that upon changing your outfit from the Wardrobe menu, you may lose any equipments/weapons you have on your character.

This job is considered unfinished/not complete and is currently not receiving any updates. Keep this in mind when doing the job.

Coast Guard is one of the specialized jobs within Transport Tycoon. As a member of the coast guard, you'll go out to sea to rescue people on their sinking boats, taking them back to safety.

Getting Started:

1. Go to the Specialized Job markerSpecialized Job at the Merryweather HQ. (Shown in the following picture)

2. Go to the orange Job Selector circle and choose Coast Guard, then walk into the large nearby white circle and press E to go on duty.

3. Coast Guard is a co-op job where you can work with other people. If other people in your session are still out at sea saving people, you cannot join in right away. You will have to wait until the current rescue is finished and all coast guards have come back to HQ. Once this happens, you will get a message saying that the fleet has returned, if you want to join, now is your chance. After this, there will not be another callout until the fleet returns once again.

4. After around 30 seconds of receiving the callout, you will get 3 new blinking blips on your map, one for a SwiftCG Swift all the way out on the helipad, another one for a PredatorCG Predator in the left docking spot, and another one for a Predator on a TrailerCG Predator Trailer. Head over to the icon for the vehicle of your choice and press E to spawn.

The Rescue:

5. A little while after spawning the vehicle, a white circle with a question mark will appear on your map

CG Search

imgsize

200px

This circle shows you the search area for the boat in need, head to the area and attempt to locate the stranded boat.

6. Once you or another member of the team finds the boat, everyone will get an icon on their map for the boats location.CG Rescue

7. Get close to the boat to start rescuing those onboard. PredatorCG Predator can pick up 3 injured people while SwiftCG Swift can only pick up 1 person at a time and needs to deliver them to the nearest hospital.

8. Once you have people onboard, head to the waiting ambulance marked on your mapParamedic Station to drop off the survivors. You can make a second trip if there's still more to rescue.

9. After everyone has been rescued, you're done! Return to Coast Guard HQCG HQ for your next call.

pages.h:
CollinsCo Cabbies


As a CollinsCo Cabbie you'll take on the role of a taxi driver. Not just any taxi driver however, you'll be expected to be well on time. In this job you will be rewarded with money and Business Experience.

Getting Started

  • Go to the Cabbie Depot CocoCabbieDepot blip. On the east side of the parking lot is a door with an orange job marker, Choose CollinsCo Cabbies.
  • Head over to the stairs in the northern part of the lot, go on duty at the blue marker.
  • Find any vehicle that can carry at least one passenger. You can use your own vehicles.
  • Your status is set as available, drive around, looking for a passenger CocoFriend 22px.
    • A VIP passenger is guaranteed to spawn if the Idle Cycles reach 30/30.
  • Horn (default E) to alert your passenger. A GPS route will guide you to the destination CocoDestination 23px.
  • Drive to the destination.
  • Upon dropping off the passenger, you'll receive money and Business Experience.
    • Arriving within the time bonus will increase the amount of money (?) and Experience earned.

Streak

As you complete Cabbie callouts, you increase your streak by 1, this will increase the amount of exp you gain per dropoff.

The Cabbies streak starts at 6 exp. The exp for a dropoff is dependent on the distance of the delivery, the current streak and if you manage to deliver in time.

The formula for raw exp: (distance) * ((100 + streak)/100) * (time bonus)

Where distance can have the value 6 exp for deliveries that are less than 3500m away and 7.5 exp for ones that are further away and the time bonus is a *2 Multiplier if you manage to deliver in time.

Roxwood CollinsCo Cabbie

There is a new starting point for CoCo Cabbie, you can find this on the map in Roxwood. You need to go to the depot and enter to change job to CollinsCo Cabbie, you can spawn a cabbie at the depot or bring your own 2 seater vehicle. Then follow all the steps above after you have got the job and gone on duty.

HUD

Icons

  • CocoCabbieDepot CollinsCo Cabbie Depot
  • CocoDestination CollinsCo Destination
  • CocoFriend CollinsCo Passenger

Here you see all Commands/Hotkeys the server currently has. For easier/faster use they can be bound to a key, for more information head to Binds Page.

General Commands

Chat Commands

/ems [message]

Paramedic Dispatch (Can only be used in the EMS job)

/mec [message]

Mechanic Dispatch (Can only be used in the Mechanic job)

/cab [message]

Cab Dispatch (Can only be used in the CollinsCo's Cabbie job)

/con [message]

Train Conductor (Can only be used in the Train Conductor job)

/fd [message]

Fire Dispatch (Can only be used in the Firefighter job)

/passive

Turns on/off passive mode.
Player level 10+ is required to toggle this.
Certain areas have enforced passive mode, such as the City Hall and Airports.

/pause_chat_colors

Disables animated chat colors

/simple_chat

Hides chat titles (Currently can not be disabled until you relog)

/atc [message]

Custom Flight ATC message (Can only be used in the Airline Pilot & Cargo Pilot jobs). This should not be used to reserve a runway for takeoff or landing - use the TAB menu for that.

/buy [message]

Signals you want to buy something

/sell [message]

Signals you are selling something

/msg or /dm or /m [user id] [message]

Direct message a player

/reply or /r [message]

Reply to your last direct message

/help

The F7 help menu

/rules

Displays the server rules

/tycoon-refresh

Refreshes your linked discord (used when e.g. you lose access to your discord account and you want to change it, requires relogging)

/discord

Opens the Discord join invite for our community server

/shop

Opens the Tebex shop

/mp view [user id]

Views all listings from a given player

/mp search [item name]

Searches for an item on the marketplace

/faction

The Faction menu

/ignore [Type]

Ignores specific message types in chat. For example, "/ignore leveling" ignores all level up messages system, leveling, company, faction, radio, dispatch, globalchat, dms, perks

/ignore [user-id]

Ignores specific user from appearing in your chat. For example, "/ignore 123456"

/unignore [user-id]

Unignores specific user to re-appear in your chat. For example, "/unignore 123456"

/ignores

Shows all channels you ignore

/calc or /math

Basic in-game calculator

/gamepad

Opens the Gamepad Interface to configure gamepads and controllers to work in-game

/+togglesmoke

Toggles smoke on/off (needs to be in the air)

/setsmoke [0-255] [0-255] [0-255] [0-2]

Allows you to choose the color of your smoke based on RGB values, the last number is the size of the smoke

/seat [seat]

Changes seat (works only while seated in a vehicle) e.g. "/seat -1" changes to Driver seat.
This command has a 3 Minutes cooldown to avoid exploiting.

/stance [0.5-1.5]

Applies stance (wheel thickness) to your current car. Must have custom wheels applied. Stance will not persist if you leave the area.

/blip

Opens the Blip settings menu

/compass

Opens the Compass settings menu

/garage [type]

Marks the closest Garage
Types are bike, car, cab, trailer, aircraft, helicopter, boat, bicycle

/replace_blip [sprite] [url]

Replaces a map blip with a custom one

/report [Issue]

Opens the player report menu or reports an issue (leave [Issue] blank if you want to open the player report menu)

/channel [Channel name]

Command to switch between chat channels/tabs

/designer

Shortcut for the Airport Designer website tool

/design-test

Command to test airports in-game

/metrics

Opens the Tycoon Metrics settings

/milestones or /unlocks

Views skill and job milestones

/screenshot_mode or /toggle_ui

Turns on/off screenshot mode

/dev_pos

Saves your x, y, z coordinates (You must be in a company to use it)

/radio

Opens the Radio settings menu

/simrad

Shows the Simulator Radio Interface

/hype

Shows the Hype Radio Interface

/credits

Displays content credits https://tycoon-2epova.users.cfx.re/credits/ website

/api

All API commands. For more info please head to the API page

/visual

Opens the Visual settings menu

/playerlist_font [fontFamily]

Allows you to change the font of player list [X] (you do need to have the font installed)

/item [modifier]

Command to use an item from your inventory, mostly used in binds. Modifier simulates the way you press the option (-1 is Left Arrow, 0 (or none) is Enter, 1 is Right Arrow)

/toggle_old_chat

Toggles Old Chat (all messages show in the Chat tab)

/filter

Applies a filter to your screen. Type the command multiple times to cycle through the available filters (check the F8 console to see which filter number is currently applied)

/f7 [query] or /wiki [query]

Opens the wiki on the specified page. If no such page exists, the search results are opened instead.

/racing_ghost_enable

Enable a visual "ghost" for Racing World Records. It's not accurate in position and mimics your own movement.

/racing_ghost_disable

Disables the visual "ghost"

/toggle_xp

Enable the experience bars to remain at the bottom right of your screen instead of disappearing after some time. To disable, reconnect.

/set_vehicle_engine_audio [model]

Change the vehicle engine audio by specifying a specific vehicle model.
To save the change, enter and exit Los Santos Customs.

, (COMMA) . (PERIOD)

T (LETTER T)

Opens Text Chat input box

Page Up/Down

X (LETTER X)

Show Player List (HOLD). Use ↑ or ↓ to navigate the player list, ← or → to page through players (useful on OneSync)

TAB (TABULATOR)

Open/Close Aircraft ATC Menu

ALT (ALTERNATE)

(Hold) ALT to enable and press Right Mouse Button (RMB) to free the cursor |-

Open the Radial Menu

M (LETTER M)

Open the Main Menu

F7 (FUNCTION KEY 7)

Open the Help Menu

7 (NUMBER 7)

Toggle In-Game Camera

8 (NUMBER 8)

Open/Close Vehicle Menu

Y (LETTER Y)

Toggle Cruise / Autopilot Control (letter Z on QWERTZ Keyboards)

F8 (FUNCTION KEY 8)

Opens the Console. (Type "quit" and press the "Enter" key to quit the game.)

Attach the trailer (Hold H to detach).

- (HYPHEN), = (EQUAL), ` (BACKTICK)

Turn signals in that order: left, right, both

decorators

Useful to figure out the User ID of the vehicle owner.returns error when not in vehicle.

The server uses a custom siren control system, we call it Emergency Siren Control, or ESC for short.

Company rules

  • To ensure all companies remain a fair and positive environment in Transport Tycoon we have laid out specific rules for the members and management of companies.
  1. You must be minimum level 30 Strength to join any company.
  2. When you leave a company you must wait 7 days from the time you leave before you can join another company.
  3. Company vs company drama, trash talking, and bullying is prohibited.
  4. Company vehicles must only be used for company work or leisure.
  5. No exploiting of any kind, if you find an exploit within your company it must be reported immediately and not shared.
  6. Companies may hire and fire whoever they want at anytime for breaking these rules or clearly laid out rules for the specific company but.....
  7. Companies and their management are expected to be fair and respectful at all times, bullying by companies and management will not be tolerated.

If you have evidence of someone breaking these company rules, or feel a company/CEO/manager has bullied or treated you unfairly, contact Stormm_29#0029 through Discord.

Useful information

Leaving / Joining Companies

Before you try to join a company, be sure to have level 30 strength and other requirements (specific to each company) listed above.

When you leave a company you will get a 7-day cooldown, if you have a cooldown you can't join another company.

If a company gets removed from the game you will not get a 7-day cooldown.

Closed companies

  • Below are the companies which have been closed.


For more information regarding the closures, see the #annoucements channel on the Tycoon Gaming Discord.

First Responders LLC

- EMS/Paramedic & Trucking Company.

  • As of June 22nd 2021 FRLLC has become public.
    • FRLLC's jobs, vehicles, storage (Pillbox Hill Storage Unit) and perks have been integrated into normal gameplay for everyone to access and enjoy.
  • FRLLC members are able to join/apply to any of the other companies with no cooldown!
  • Most of the "FRLLC" items are still usable in the EMS job.

Bay Area Towing

- Mechanic/Towing Company.

  • The company was closed on the May 2nd 2020.
  • All BAT members have been removed from the company and are free to join/apply to any of the other companies above with no cooldown!
  • BAT members can still get their BAT vehicle trunk contents, but cannot store new items.
  • All BAT company items can now be trashed.

Globe Oil

- Train & Trucking Company.

  • The company was closed on the September 1st 2018.
  • Globe Oil members are able to join/apply to any of the other companies with no cooldown!
  • Custom Globe Oil semis & self storage (Palmer-Taylor Power Station) are now accessible for everyone to enjoy.

Courier is a variant on the regular Trucking in the server. You are responsible for delivering packages to houses, stores, and even warehouses. Unlike regular trucking, you will not need to purchase a truck or materials. Everything required to do the job is given to you free of charge. This is a perfect job for beginners and advanced players alike.

Getting Started

  • Head to the Specialized Job marker Specialized Job in Vinewood.
  • Select “Courier” in the orange circle at this location:
  • Head into the white circle beside the orange circle and select a route:

Getting a truck

Once you have started one of these routes you can then spawn yourself a mule delivery truck, this is done by walking into the white circle beside the route selector, it is a yellow question mark on your map.UPS Vehicle Spawner

Getting Cargo

Once you have got your truck you are now going to need cargo, to do this follow these steps.

  • Go to the red circle marked "Destination" on your map.UPS Depot
  • Walk into the white circle on the ground.
  • Pick up your cargo and carry it over to the back of your Mule and load it into the truck. Your mule holds 50 cargo so this will take a few trips.
  • Repeat this process until you have sufficiently loaded your Mule and are ready to deliver these packages!

Delivering Packages

Delivering packages is similar to loading them up, follow these steps to deliver your packages.

  • Drive to the yellow ‘Destination’ markers on your map.UPS Drop 3 You will notice the markers have numbers on them, this number is how many packages you will be delivering here.
  • Once you have arrived at a destination walk to the back of your truck and pick up cargo just like how you loaded it. If you are delivering multiple cargoes, then hold E at the back of your truck until you have the required cargo for the delivery.
  • Walk your cargo to the white circle at the delivery point and deliver the cargo.
  • Repeat this process at all the destinations.
  • If you run out of cargo you need to go to any of the red ‘Destination’ dots on your map and refill your truck
  • Once you have delivered to all your locations you can go back to where you started and start another route.

pages.h:
Dock Handler is a specialized job in which you need to deal with the moving, lifting & loading containers on different trucks to earn your money.

Getting Started

  • Go to the Specialized Job marker Specialized Job at South LS Terminal.

  • Go to the orange Job Selector circle and choose Dock Handler.
  • Go to the nearby blue circle and go on duty.
  • Head over the road to the Vehicle Warehouse Vehicle Warehouse and spawn a Handler.
  • Using the Handler pick up the container indicated by Target C
  • Drop this container off onto the truck waiting at Target D
  • The truck you have just loaded will then drive off and you will get rewarded with money.
  • Now you can move onto the next container and repeat.

The paramedicsEMS emoji of Transport Tycoon are lifesavers. Performing this job will be saving the lives of many poor AI.
There is one main objective as EMS: Receive AI calls to revive and transport them to the hospital.

Getting started

You must have level 5 <a data-p

"strength">strength to do EMS missions!

reminder
  • Visit any Job CenterJob Center job center (except for Life Invader) and select the EMS job.
  • Purchase an EMS vehicle from the Car Dealership Car Dealer or a helicopter from the Aircraft Dealership Aircraft Shop.
    • The helicopters require at least level 5 Helicopter Pilot.
  • Optionally, you can get a paramedic uniform from Pillbox Hospital Hospital.
  • Players looking to earn slightly more experience should consider carrying defib kits (+10% exp).

Objective: Receive AI calls to revive and transport them to the hospital

  • Head to one of the 10 Paramedic Stations. Paramedic Station EMS Helicopter can land on the rooftop (If the hospital has a designated Heli landing Pad).
  • Walk to the entrance or rooftop main door (For EMS Helicopter) and press E to go on duty.
  • Wait for an automatic call to occur.
  • Follow the GPS to the location marked on your map. EMS Friend
  • Press E to revive the AI.
  • The revived patient will get into your EMS Vehicle.
  • Head back to the hospital now marked on your map with the patient. EMS Target D To drop off the patient you must drive your ambulance inside the orange circle or there will be an orange circle on the rooftop to land with the EMS Helicopter.
  • Congratulations, you’ve successfully completed an AI callout and will now receive Medic Exp!

In the event where you're unable to revive a patient, the patient is not reachable or the patient is stuck after reviving: Enter your vehicle and attempt to drive away. If the patient does not teleport inside the vehicle, cancel the mission by pressing M ► Stop Job and then head back to the Paramedic Station to go back on duty.

info

If when reviving an patient while on duty the patient refuses to enter the helicopter then fly to the dropoff point, get out and get in a couple of times, the subject should eventually teleport and you'll finish the job.

info

Streak

Be sure to do at least 1 callout in a 2 day period to keep your streak, otherwise it will reset back to 0 reminder As you deliver patients to the hospital, you build up a streak. At every streak threshold you earn more Experience and EXP Tokens for every patient dropped off.

This threshold occurs at specific intervals. starting from 10 and increasing progressively. Initially, it rises by 10 until reaching 50. From there, the jumps become larger, first reaching 100, then 250, and continuing to grow. The increments move from 500 to 750, then 1000, and continue in steps of 250 until reaching 2500.

(20 30 40 50 100 250 500 750 1000 1250 1500 1750 2000 2250 2500)

Your streak will reset after 48 real life hours.

Your streak is visible under M→Identity. Otherwise it is also visible to the right of your minimap when on duty and available, but not while On Route.

Event Scripts

Event Scripts are small independent resources that contain one server and one client script.

They can be added to the server by administrators and enabled/disabled by staff.

The purpose of Event Scripts is to allow custom stuff for events that the community can contribute to.

Example stuff can be:

- Custom minigame stuff, like weapon spawning and score counters.
- Tiny features like flashing the headlights when honking.
- Toggleable Noclip for all players

There's really no limit to what the scripts can do.

Source Code for a couple of the scripts we already made: Outline Player Vehicles Flash Headlights When Honking Allow /nc (Noclip) For Everyone

These scripts are essentially just snippets of client and or server code that do certain things.

If you wish to contribute with cool small things you've made, contact staff!

location

Anywhere

The white circle on the map indicates that there's an EXP Boost hidden somewhere in this circle. It will only appear when you get close to it so grab a digiscanner, your favorite vehicle, and get hunting!

Information

Inside the white zone, there is a Medi-kit hidden somewhere within that area. They are mostly in, below, or on houses.

  • The Hidden EXP Boost makes a beeping sound. The closer you are, the louder you will hear it.
  • If you do not currently have a 15% bonus experience active, you will receive one automatically activated when you collect an EXP Boost.
  • If you have an active 15% Boost and gather another one, you will receive the physical boosts in your inventory, such as 5%, 10%, and 15%. You can also come upon them at random while traveling. (Active Exp bonus can be viewed from the M menu → Identity.)

How to find Hidden Exp Boosts

The Informant

Head to the City Hall City Hall and on the EAST side of the building down a set of stairs you will find the informant, aka Monke For a small fee of $75,000 the informant will give you a location of an EXP boost.

Digiscanner

The other method is a handy tool called the Digiscanner which can be obtained from:

  • The Market (Alien Workshop).
  • Via Prospecting (Legendary 0.09%)
  • It can also be bought/sold on the Marketplace or traded through Player-to-Player selling.

When using the Digiscanner, the bars will turn blue when there is an EXP Boost in that direction, so follow that blue light until the bars fill up and it will lead you right to the EXP Boost. Its range is about ~500m / 0,3 miles

The best method is to combine both of these two tools together!

Benefits of collecting EXP Boosts

Not only will you get a good stash of EXP boosts in your inventory but also:

  • Collecting 100 EXP Boosts unlocks the Spacedocker vehicle and can be purchased from the car dealership for FREE.
  • It also allows you to use the (Flying) Deluxo when you collect 100 EXP Boosts.
  • Collecting 500 EXP Boosts unlocks a MONKE Chat Title and a permanent 25% EXP boost.
  • Collecting 10,000 (10K) EXP Boosts unlocks a ZULU Chat Title.
  • EXP Boosts can be redeemed for your own benefit or sold on the Marketplace for some cash.

Spaceship Parts

Similar to collecting EXP Boosts. However, In order to collect Spaceship Parts, It is done through:

  • Using the Spacedocker, which allows you to receive Spaceship Parts when collecting EXP Boosts.
  • Alternatively, there is also the Oppressor F/S that can allow you to locate Spaceship Parts as well!

The last vehicle entered must be either the Spacedocker or the F/S to be able to get a spaceship part in your inventory

warn

You can borrow the Oppressor F/S from a friend as it isn’t locked like the Spacedocker!

reminder

Spaceship Parts can be used at:

  • The Market (Alien Workshop).
  • Or can be sold on the Marketplace.
  • You can also trade them with other Players.

Experience are points earned for completing tasks in jobs. The higher level you become in a job, the more experience you will need to level up. Higher job levels will also allow you to complete more complex job tasks that reward more experience.

Types of Experience

There are many types of experiences. Completing a job task rewards you experience for that job, as well as player experience and sometimes also physical or other types of experiences at the same time.

  • Business
  • Emergency:

pages.h:
FactionsFaction are player-run businesses that can be expanded by purchasing upgrades in the form of "perks". The base cost of creating a faction is $500M, and purchasing perks must be done using Faction Credits (₡), which can only be acquired through taxation of the faction members' income and redemption of Faction Credits Cards.

How to join a faction

You can join any Public Faction by typing "/faction" in chat and browsing the public factions in the list that appears.

  • When you join a faction, you gain access to all of its perks.

Only Factions that have set their faction as public can be joined without an invite.

warn

Private Factions have their own sets of membership rules, so it's best to ask someone in the faction about them.

  • Private factions won't show up in the /faction list and will require an invite from a Manager (or higher role) of that faction.

A faction cooldown will also be applied that will prevent you from leaving or joining another faction within 24 hours of the time you joined your current one. The join cooldown does not apply to and is not affected by you leaving a faction.

warn

Leaving a faction

  • Leaving a Faction will disconnect you from the server. However, joining a Faction won't.
  • If you left a Faction while you have items in your Faction Storage, it will stay until you join back.
  • In order to leave a Faction as a President, go into the member list and kick yourself. You are given the President role again when you join back. Note that you need at least ₡2.5M faction credits to be able to join again.
    • In case it's a Private Faction, have someone in your Faction with invitation privileges to invite you back. You also get your role back.

How to create a faction

First, be aware that creating a faction costs $500M upfront, but further perk upgrades cannot be purchased with cash. Perks have to be purchased with credits, which can't be deposited directly to the faction; they must be earned through the Faction Tax. For this reason, newer players will likely be better off joining a faction that already exists (see above).

  1. Open the /faction menu (type "/faction" in chat)
  2. Select "create faction"
  3. Select "faction name" and enter a valid name (see below disclaimer)
  4. Select "faction tag" and enter a valid tag (this appears in chat next to members' names!)
  5. Confirm the settings and purchase your faction ($500M)

The faction HQ will be permanently locked in your current location.

warn

Disclaimer

Faction names and tags shall not be offensive or disruptive in any way. We can and will terminate factions where needed. (Staff Discretion)

Faction Credits

The faction's President and its Officers use Faction Credits (₡) to purchase perks for the faction's members. These Credits are collected mainly as a fixed percentage of its members' income via the Faction Tax (settable from 1% to 75%, default 5%). Credits can also be obtained in smaller amounts by using Faction Credits Cards; these can be found in treasure chest drops or bought from other players.

Players cannot donate money directly to the faction; all Credits in the faction balance must come from the taxation of its members' income, or via direct deposits from Faction Credits Cards. Additionally, Faction Credits cannot be withdrawn from the faction balance.

Faction Member List

The Member List can be viewed by any rank above Member (Managers, Officers, and the President). The list can be used to see who is in the faction, and how many credits each member has contributed to the faction balance.

Additionally, Managers are given access to invite and kick members, and Officers are further trusted with the ability to promote members to Manager. Only the President may promote members to the rank of Officer.

Faction Hierarchy

Rank

Description

Member

The Member can use every perk a Faction Officer or President has bought. They can also donate Faction Credits to the faction with Faction Credit Cards, which can be obtained from Treasure Chests.

Manager

A Manager has the additional abilities to view and managing Members of the faction, including inviting and kicking them.

Officer

An Officer can do anything a Manager can, but Officers also have access to promote members to Manager and buy/manage perks for the faction.

President

The President is the owner of the faction. They have access to every part of it, including faction upgrades, changing the MOTD, setting the faction tax rate, promoting members to Officer or Manager, closing the faction and setting the faction as public or private.

How to invite members

A faction President, Officer, or Manager can invite members.

  1. Open the /faction menu
  2. Select "management"
  3. Select "manage members"
  4. Select "invite members" and choose the person to invite
  5. Confirm your selection

The invited player now has to open their /faction menu and view their Invites.

It costs ₡2.5M faction credits every time someone joins your faction through the public faction menu. There is no cost when a faction staff member (Manager, Officer or President) invites someone to the faction.

How to promote members

  • Faction Presidents and Officers can promote members to Manager.
  • Faction Presidents can promote members to Officer.
  1. Open the /faction menu
  2. Select "management"
  3. Select "manage members"
  4. Select "member list" and choose the member to promote
  5. Select the "promote to" option
  6. Confirm your selection

The user should now be promoted.

How to demote members

The steps are similar to a promotion, but the button will instead say "demote from"

Faction MOTD

A message of the day can be seen in the info part of the /faction menu.

To change the MOTD, the Faction President can go to the President menu and click "change MOTD", then enter a new MOTD. The MOTD can be formatted to your own liking using HTML formatting.

Faction Perks

The President and the faction's Officers have the ability to manage faction perks. They can be purchased using Faction Credits (₡), which are obtained mainly through the tax rate set by the faction President, which is applied to the faction members' income.

When purchased, perks will be placed where the purchaser is currently standing. They can only be placed within a 350m radius of the faction's HQ (extends to 550m with the 550m HQ Range Bonus perk). Note that if your faction does not have enough Credits for a particular perk, it will not display in the list of perks available for purchase.

Faction Self Storage

In case of changing factions all items in self storage will stay there till you join back said faction. Items won't be deleted or transferred after leaving a faction.

warn

Perks List

Faction Member Limit

The default faction member limit is set at 50 members. This can be increased at a cost of $1b by 50 members with a limit of 500 members.

Faction Discord Updates

Faction Presidents can set a channel for Faction updates which will show MOTD Changes, Changes in Faction Tax, Perk Purchases, Removal of Perks and members joining and leaving.

Only Faction Presidents can set the webhook or increase the Faction member limit

warn

Trivia

  • On August 12th 2025 Public factions were reintroduces after being disabled along with other Faction updates
  • On 5 March 2021, the Marketplace perk was removed due to exploiting potential.
  • On 22 January 2021, speed boosts (15x and 25x) were introduced as faction perks. The base faction range was also extended from 250 to 350 meters, and a crafting speed perk was added to make processing (for trucking) go faster while in range of the faction HQ. Most significantly, the ability to place props was removed, meaning some factions lost things like shortcut bridges and floating runways.
  • As of 1 September 2021, slots machine perk was removed following the removal of gambling skill.
