Money or Cash is the currency used in Transport Tycoon it is used for crafting in-game items and trading with other players. It can be obtained through numerous sources, such as doing jobs and selling items. Eventually investing in businesses will earn you money passively.

Acquiring Money

Working

  • Doing most jobs in general is a reliable source of direct income. The amount of money earned is determined based on your job & equipment level. In general: the higher they are, the more money you get.

You may resort to other means of obtaining money in which you can increase your earnings (in)directly via:

  • Selling Items on the Marketplace Marketplace 24, it's a quick way to earn cash. Be aware of the 5% service fee. Don't always go off of the estimated marketplace value, if you are unsure on how your price things, asking in the chat will probably get some people to help you. The value is easy to manipulate and is sometimes much higher than existing offers on the Marketplace. You also lose another 10% once the offer has been sold.
  • Buying and investing in Businesses Business Sale, a long-term process which generates passive income but will only earn you profit in the long run.
  • Visiting the Fountain of WealthFountain will give you an amount of cash donated by other players to get you started.
  • Using various codes will also give new players a head start.

Tips

Beginner Tips

While there are many ways to obtaining money, here are a few tips that may help you decide how you can make money efficiently.

  • Garbage Collector, Train Conductor and EMS are some of the best jobs for newer players. This is due to their low starting equipment costs and decent to good scaling, especially for EMS due to the streak system.
  • Trucking: One of the highest paid end-game jobs. Process and deliver goods. Advanced routes will unlock upon leveling up. They will earn you more, but will require better and more expensive Trailers.
    • Will be used in combination with Vehicle Trunks
    • It is recommended to increases your Strength level. Strength increases your inventory capacity, which will become a priority for jobs that require you to transport heavy goods.
    • Don't be afraid to spend cash on better Trailers for trucking. They will allow you to be more efficient over time as you will be able to transport more goods at the same time.
  • Doing side activities such as Prospecting, Treasure Hunting or EXP Boost Hunting and then selling the items you receive to other players.

Advanced Tips

  • In the process of doing Trucking, It can be more worth selling the products to other Players via Self Storages rather than exporting them to the NPC/AI. Given that some materials, such as Concrete are used in advanced trucking which increases its sale value when trading is applied.
  • Producing and selling the Bonus EXP items you get from doing Jobs to other players is also a really good way of making money. This is most effective for more advanced players with the Cargo Pilot Perk activated and high Base EXP due to multiple Experience Boosts.
    • This is especially effective for Jobs that have active streaks, since those jobs give very high amounts of base exp.
  • In general jobs with streaks, they do give more money and exp at high streak, with some jobs not even having a maximum streak.

title

image

location

Overview

The Pandas Illicit Gains Syndicate (P.I.G.S.) is a robbery job that provides waypoint-marked locations to rob. Upon arriving at the location, follow the prompt to ready up and begin the heist. Heists can be completed either solo or with a group.

  • Once you receive the P.I.G.S. Robbery Job from the location (Level 30 Strength required):*
  • Head inside and approach the bar to either join or create a party. The party host can select a difficulty tier between 1 and 7.
  • After selecting "Start Heist," a location will be provided. Once all players are ready, weapons will be given and waves of enemies will begin spawning.
  • You gain EXP in three skills: Hunting, Business, and Player.
  • If you die during the heist, it will fail and a new location will be assigned.

Rewards

XP is distributed as follows: Hunting - 40% Business - 40% Player - 20%

The amount of XP awarded is based on your streak (Click here to see XP formulas). This increases depending on your heist tier and streak.

Max streak that can be gained is 1000 (1k).

Money distribution for a solo player at a streak of 1 can average between $9000 and $40000, dependent on the tier of heist and streak. (For more details see The money formula that is used in the calculations.

The bank offers several loans, through the Loan Office Pacific Standard. They range from $50,000 (50K) up to $150,000,000 (150M). To take any loan, you must currently be free of debt. You can also only have one loan active at a time. Loans are automatically paid back when you receive money from jobs.

As a Parking Enforcement Officer, you will protect the streets and citizens of Los Santos from unruly parking and dish out parking fines!

Getting Started

1. Go to the Specialized Job marker Specialized Job(9/-) at the S.A Parking Council HQ (Shown in the following picture).

2. In the Specialized Job marker, select the Parking Enforcement Officer job

3. There will be a white circle where you can spawn the PEO vehicle on the right side of the entrance in a parking space.

4. Once you've spawned the PEO vehicle slowly drive next to parked cars to scan them. After scanning a parked vehicle is a chance to ticket the vehicle and receive a ticket commission.

5. Find the next vehicle and repeat!

Demonstration

Unlockable Vehicles

Brute Enforcer- 500 scan in one session
LCPD Premier- Issue 100 parking tickets
LSPD Aleutian- Issue 250 Parking tickets
Prison Coach- Finish at least 100 Bus routes.

These Vehicles can be acquired upon completing the above challenges at Davis County Sherriff office.

pages.h:
Hello and welcome to the Perks Page! Here you will find information to help you understand what Skill Perks are, what they can do, and how to obtain them.

  • Perks are unlockable advantages which allow you to do things much easier or in general make jobs more hassle-free.

How do I obtain Perks?

  • Perks are obtained at random by accumulating EXP in certain jobs; each job has its own unique perk, and there is no predefined EXP at which you will receive one.
  • Perks are uncommon and are intended to be something that demands either little or a lot of work to obtain. However, the chance of getting a perk is determined by the amount of experience you currently have.
  • You are guaranteed to earn a Skill Perk after reaching one million experience in any job.

The actual chance of getting a perk is 1 / [(1000000 - Total EXP) / Earned EXP]

More information on Skill Perks and how to activate them:

  • After receiving a perk, you will get the option to activate it by going to: M → Phone/Services → Skill Perks.
  • You can only have 1 active Perk at a time.
  • There is a 1 hour cooldown to Perks upon activating one. When the cooldown is over, you will be notified. You can then switch to another Perk.
  • Switching to None option in the Perks Menu wont reset your cooldown.
  • Active perk & cooldown timer can be viewed from the Identity menu.
  • First perk giving 5% experience bonus
  • Each next perk grants 2.5% Permanent experience boosts to all XP earned, which gives us exactly 50% bonus with all perks

Which perks are currently available?

text

‍Hey! The people of Los Santos are hungry.. you must rush around with your pizza delivery vehicle and deliver their food.. become a pizza delivery driver today.. what are you waiting for!

Getting Started

  1. Go to one of the Market (Pizza)Pizza locations in order to get the Pizza Delivery job.
    • Pizza Delivery requires your Strength to be level 30.
  2. Then go to your nearest vehicle purchasing location Car Dealer, either at Simons dealership in the city or a faction dealership.
  3. Purchase one of the FREE Food Delivery Vehicles under Vehicles → Events.
  4. Once you actually get to start the job, a menu will appear in the top right corner of your screen. This tells you the food and location of what the "customer" has ordered.
  5. Go to the Pizza MarketPizza again and pick up the items needed for the order, for example, Pizza/Expensive Water/Fries/Chicken Nuggets, etc.
    • Alternatively, take your time to stock up and completely fill the trunk.
  6. Follow your map waypointDelivery to your customer's address, and then simply walk over the yellow circle to deliver the items.
  7. You get given money, strength, and player exp for your delivery efforts.
  8. Simply repeat and increase your position on the leaderboard.

You have to use the event vehicles when doing this job. Keep in mind that the pizza delivery vehicles are a very useful because of the trunk capacity.

reminder

Pizza Delivery Vehicles

You need to get the job first in order to buy these vehicles from the car dealership.

Trivia

Originally, Pizza Delivery was reintroduced as an event. It ran from 26 January 2022 until 26 March 2022. Every week during this period, the top three players were rewarded by Collins.
The event ran again from April to June 2026.

The PostOPPostOP emoji job is a tiered job that has an aircraft and ground delivery route. You can choose to depart from the PostOP HQ with a truck full of packages. Maybe you feel like flying? Well go on and buy a PostOP aircraft (there's four!) and deliver packages to multiple airports.

In order to gain PostOP <a data-p

"Experience">Experience, you need to do PostOP Air Delivery.
PostOP ground only gives Bonus EXP Tokens.

PostOP Delivery Driver

  1. Head to any Job Center Job Center job center (except for Life Invader) and change your job to PostOP employee.
  2. Make sure you buy the PostOP truck from the Vehicle Shop!Car Dealer
  3. Head over to the PostOP HQ, marked by a blue package icon near the docks.PostOP HQ

  • Drive into the large blue circle to go on duty, then drive into the white circle to the right to pick up mail.

    • The mail will start flowing into your inventory. If you want to fill the trunk as well, have the trunk open. This can be done with B → Trunk or M → Car Options → Access Trunk.
    • Keep an eye on the bars to the left of your minimap to quickly see how full you are. The whiter the bar, the fuller.

  • Proceed with the routes that are marked via the map.Mail Marker

    • The mail has to be in your inventory when delivering. If you don't have enough mail, or when the mail is in your trunk, the marker will still disappear without rewarding tokens!

    warn

    • You will get 10 EXP Tokens (PostOP) for each mail delivered (2-4 per stop).
    • You will get 2500 EXP Tokens (PostOP) if you finish the complete route.
    You will not receive any money from doing PostOP ground. You can however convert the Exp Tokens into bonus EXP and sell this to players via the Marketplace or by trading face to face.

    PostOP Vehicles

    PostOP Air Delivery

    You must have at least level 5 <a data-p

    "Cargo Pilot">Cargo Pilot to start PostOP Air Deliveries!

    warn
    1. Head to any Job Center Job Center job center (except for Life Invader) and change your job to PostOP Employee.
    2. Purchase a PostOP aircraft from the LSIA Aircraft Dealership Aircraft Shop.
    3. Head towards the PostOP Airport Hangar Aircraft Garage at the airport south of Buccaneer Way and spawn your PostOP Airplane.
    4. Load up packages by taxiing to the PostOP Start icon PostOP Start .

  • Fly the packages to the designated airport, indicated by the same icon PostOP Start.

  • Unload your packages. After unloading you will receive money, PostOP, and Cargo Pilot experience.

  • Continue your route until your capacity (indicated on the right side of your minimap) is empty.

    • Return to the PostOP airport if you wish to load and deliver more packages.
    If at any point during an active route you leave your aircraft, you will have 60 seconds to re-enter the aircraft, otherwise your route will be abandoned.

    ATC

    For the PostOP Air job, correct usage of the Air Traffic Control system will reward the player with extra Experience on correct takeoffs and landings. Incorrect usage will result in a Runway Utilization Detection System (RUDS) violation. This applies a temporary 15 minute penalty.

Prospecting is a job where you try your luck at metal detecting. See what treasures lay below! Prospecting will give you both Strength and Mining XP and you may also dig up items that increase your luck at Fishing.

Getting Started

  1. First you will first need to get hold of a Prospecting Scanner, You can obtain one of these at the Market(Fishing/Diving)Diving Market for the cost of 10 skill tokens.
  2. Head over to the current prospecting area indicated on the map by Prospecting
  3. Press E to start prospecting.
  4. Roam the 200m prospecting circle hunting for treasure. Prospecting works like a game of hot and cold, when you get close to something beneath the ground a green circle will appear, it will transition from Green to Yellow to Red and the beeping frequency will increase as you get closer.
  5. When you have located the treasure you will be prompted to dig, hit left click to do so.
  6. Once dug up you will be rewarded with your treasure along with Strength and Mining XP.
    Keep in mind that digging up the same spot that's already being dug by another player will only reward the first person to dig.
  7. Repeat

Note:The prospecting area is selected at random and will only change each time the server is restarted.

title

Pure mode removal

text_color

#FFFFFF

text_size

16px

text

Transport Tycoon no longer requires you to have pure mode set to 1. This page is kept in case this changes again in the future. Keep Pure mode at 0 for now.

In order to play in Transport Tycoon, your FiveM needs to be set to pure mode. By default, it is not on pure mode. This causes you to have to restart FiveM every time in order to join the server. There are several ways to start FiveM in pure mode to avoid having to restart the client.
Described below are two methods, each with their own advantages.

Method 1:Starting FiveM in Pure Mode

If you start FiveM in pure mode, you will be able to join any pure server without having to be prompted to restart.
To do this, right click your FiveM.exe (which you use to start FiveM), click on properties and look for the Target field. Click inside the box and press End on your keyboard or navigate to the end with your arrow keys. Add -pure_1 at the end of the target. Make sure there is a space before the -pure_1. The target field should look like this:
C:\Users\Example\AppData\Local\FiveM\FiveM.exe pure_1
(do not copy-paste entire text as the target itself will be different for you)

Method 2:Join Server in Pure Mode via Desktop Shortcut

If you play on many different servers, chances are that more often than not they will not be in pure mode. Having FiveM itself be in pure mode might not be ideal in that case. Instead, you might choose to have a desktop shortcut that joins Transport Tycoon in pure mode, while your default FiveM.exe will remain in impure mode.

Main Server

Right click your desktop, choose New...Shortcut. A prompt will pop up, asking for a 'location of an item'. Copy-paste the following text into that field: fivem://connect/2epova?pure_1
Click Next, it will now ask for a name of the shortcut. Choose any name (example: TT S1). If done correctly you will now see that shortcut on your Desktop with the name that you chose, and the FiveM logo as its icon.

Beta Server

Right click your desktop, choose New...Shortcut. A prompt will pop up, asking for a 'location of an item'. Copy-paste the following text into that field: fivem://connect/njyvop?pure_1
Click Next, it will now ask for a name of the shortcut. Choose any name (example: TT BETA). If done correctly you will now see that shortcut on your Desktop with the name that you chose, and the FiveM logo as its icon.

Event Server

Right click your desktop, choose New...Shortcut. A prompt will pop up, asking for a 'location of an item'. Copy-paste the following text into that field: fivem://connect/w8j4eb?pure_1
Click Next, it will now ask for a name of the shortcut. Choose any name (example: TT EVENT). If done correctly you will now see that shortcut on your Desktop with the name that you chose, and the FiveM logo as its icon.

Troubleshooting

If you're encountering issues while setting up pure mode, feel free to join the Discord and ask for help in the #support-old chat or the #support forum.

Why Pure Mode?

The developers have chosen to force pure mode in order to prevent players from joining with modified game files. This is an extra barrier to keep out as many cheaters and bad actors as possible. The downside is that only a few whitelisted modifications are allowed.

pages.h:
As a quarry worker you can work together with other players to earn Mining and Trucking experience.

Getting Started

Head over to the Quarry in Sandy Shores and go to the Specialized Job Center (Specialized Job) and select the Quarry Worker job. Then, head over to the spawners besides the job center to spawn an excavator or dump truck.

Doing the Job

The Quarry worker job is co-op friendly, where players can choose to use the dump truck () while at Mining level 1-50. once you reach level 50 you can use the Excavator (). Additionally, when you reach Mining level 70 you gain access to a special dump truck, which you can spawn near the drop-off point for the dump trucks () The Excavator operator's job is to dig up buckets of gravel and dump it into the dump truck(s) till it's full. The dump trucks then take it to a drop-off point marked on their map (Randomly chosen point) and tip it away to receive rewards. (Mining and Trucking XP Split between the number of helpers)

In order to take the role of a truck driver, you need to spawn the dump truck at the spawner next to the Specialized Job Center (Specialized Job). When you have spawned the truck, go over to one of the excavators and park the truck up next to them, so they can dump their bucket into your truck bed. Once the bed is 100% full, you will get a waypoint marked on your map. Go over to the waypoint and follow the on-screen instructions to dump your bed and get paid.

In order to take the role of the excavator, you need to spawn an excavator at the spawner next to the Specialized Job Center (Specialized Job). When seated in your excavator, you will be given a location inside the quarry to go and dig at. Once arrived at the dig site, you will need to control the excavator and follow the on-screen instructions to dig up gravel and dump it into the tipper trucks.

(The controls for the boom follow the same control scheme as the submarine controls so if you wish to change the keybindings, change the keys for submarines.).

Rewards

The rewards are distributed to everyone who contributed to that particular drop off (Excavator Operator and Dumptruck Driver) Each Excavator Operator will receive full XP gains no matter how many excavators helped load the trucks, however, the cash reward is split between all excavators that participated. This job can be done solo as well. You can use the excavator to dig up buckets of gravel and filled your own spawned mule truck until full, head to the drop-off point, and reap your rewards!

You get 2 different EXP gains when completing a drop-off.

  • Mining
  • Trucking

As well as cash rewards for your efforts.

Leaderboards

The API supports 4 different leaderboards regarding the job. Those leaderboards can also be found scattered across the Quarry area. All Quarry worker leaderboards are persistent, so they represent the total effort a player has done.

Best Excavator Operators

  • Displayed in "buckets", you gain one point for each excavator action you do. If you fill one common tipper on your own, this will earn you 10 points ( 10 actions )
  • located ingame next to the excavator spawner

Most Cooperative Quarry Workers

  • Displayed in "deliveries" , you gain one point for being part of a delivery that more than one person contributed to.
  • Located ingame following the path starting at the "Davis Quartz" business down under the small train tunnel then straight towards those building containers

Best Dump Truck Operators

  • Displayed in "deliveries" , you gain one point for delivering a tipper load yourself.
  • Located ingame on top of the largest rubble hill, also right below the highest conveyer belt

Quarry Solo

  • Displayed in "deliveries" , you gain one point for filling a tipper without the help of other excavators and also delivering that said tipper on your own
  • Not yet ingame, can only be found in the API

Note that "deliveries" made by the ChernoTipper [Lv.70] will still only grant you one point!

See Also

Miner, another job partially taking place in the Davis Quartz Quarry.

pages.h:
Rockwell Transport Solutions


R.T.S.


R.T.S. RTS 22px (also known as Rockwell Transport Solutions) is a former company, with its jobs now available to everyone. You are responsible to either deliver ground vehicles or take to the skies and deliver helicopters and planes RTSAviatorPickup. Successful perfect deliveries of regular ground vehicles RTSVehiclePickup 22px will award you with that vehicles' one-time-use spawncard.

Getting Started

To start any aspect of R.T.S. , you need to visit the headquarters RTSHQ 22px and change your job at the job marker.-108.2 -631.9 255,125,0 RTSHQ.png true This is located at the Arcadius Business Center. The job marker is located left of the entrance (exterior). You can choose between R.T.S. Aviator, R.T.S. Professional and R.T.S. Transporter.

R.T.S. Transporter

As an R.T.S. Transporter, you can deliver regular vehicles RTSVehiclePickup 22px as well as heavier vehicles RTSHeavyPickup 22px. Regular vehicles will be faster and will also award you with a one-time-use spawncard upon successful delivery while heavier vehicles awards are doubled per individual delivery due to more time spend. Both options will award you with some cash as well as Racing and Business Experience. The more deliveries you do, the higher the rewards (see Streak).

Go to a Vehicle Pickup RTSVehiclePickup 22px or Heavy Pickup RTSHeavyPickup 22px icon, they can be found all over the map.
A menu will show up, giving you a selection of 2 to 25 vehicles (see Delivery Milestones). If you chose for heavy you will not be given a selection. Once you have chosen the vehicle you wish to deliver, a destination will be marked on your map. Drive to the destination however you wish, but make sure to not damage the vehicle too much. You will not be able to repair the vehicle and risk losing the spawn card reward.

R.T.S. Aviator

As an R.T.S. Aviator, you will be delivering small to medium-sized planes and helicopters. Go to an Aviator Pickup RTSAviatorPickup icon. A destination will be marked on your map. Fly to the destination. Upon delivery you will be awarded with small amounts of Business, Airline Pilot and Racing Experience.

ATC

R.T.S. Professional

As an R.T.S. Professional, you will be able to do both Transporter and Aviator job deliveries.

Delivery Milestones

Reaching certain total delivery milestones will allow you to choose from more vehicles at a time. This begins at a selection of 2 and goes up to 25 at 2000 deliveries. Your total R.T.S. deliveries can be viewed with the in-game /stats command. Alternatively you can also view this in Discord by visiting the #bot-commands channel and typing @Tycoon Stats Bot stats .

  • Default 2
  • 3 at 10
  • 4 at 50
  • 5 at 100
  • 6 at 200
  • 7 at 300
  • 8 at 400
  • 9 at 500
  • 12 at 750
  • 15 at 1000
  • 20 at 1500
  • 25 at 2000

Streak

The streak increases rewards linearly and starts at 7.5 EXP and 30 000$. The RTS streak has currently no maximum.

The increase is +0.075 EXP and 300$ per delivery

(This is not yet formally confirmed, but the result of the communities testing)

(Encrypted) SD cards are mainly used to unlock better or alternative routes and recipes for the Trucking job.
(Encrypted) SD cards were added in the November 10th, 2021 update.

Ways To Obtain SD Cards

  1. Prospecting - To prospect, simply go in game and find a white circle on the map, and press E to start prospecting. (Make sure you own a prospecting scanner.)
  2. Daily Chests - This is another way of getting a SD Card. Daily Chests are obtainable automatically when you log in to the server every day.
  3. Marketplace - This is the easiest way to obtain encrypted SD Cards & decrypted SD Card Recipes.
    • SD cards can not be traded (i.e. can not be given to people), but are obtainable through the Marketplace.

How do SD Cards work

  1. When you got an Encrypted SD Card, you need to keep them in your Inventory.
  2. Then go to the FIB Building.
    • In the entrance area you will see a green Marker next to the desk where you can decrypt SD-Cards (Start Scan), see what Secrets you have unlocked already (View learned Secrets) and check your current scan (Check Scan).
  3. Choose "Start Scan" and choose the decrypting method.
    • You can choose between the following options:
      • Slow Scan (48h) = FREE
      • Regular Scan (12h) = $200,000,000
      • Fast Scan (4h) = $1,000,000,000
      • Instant scan (one time) = $1,000,000,000
  4. After the scanning time, you should have the Decrypted SD Card in your Inventory.
    • IF NOT: Go to the FIB Building again and choose "Check Scan"
  5. If you want to learn the secret recipe of the SD Card you got, choose it in your Inventory and hit "Unlock secret".
    • You have learned the secret recipe now and the SD Card will disappear.

Self Storages are locations on the map where players can deposit and withdraw items. Self Storages are crucial for higher-end trucking.

Trainyard Self Storages have linked storage, meaning that you can deposit items at one Trainyard and retrieve it from another.


Free Self Storages (except for company storages) and Trainyard Self Storages will have a set deposit fee based on items weight ranging from $6.25 per kg to $31.25 (example: depositing 500 sand at $6.25 fee self-storage, you would have to pay $15,625).

The self-storage fee can be completely voided by having Storage Cards. They let you store a set of items for free. (taking our example scenario, depositing 500 sand would now be completely free, as the cards allow to waiver up to $25,000 each. However, this means that depositing will consume more than one card if you go above that value.)

Storage Cards

Storage cards can be obtained by:

  • Looting Treasure Chest [Medium Grade] (6.66%) .
  • Chocolate Egg (2.85%).
  • Opening Treasure Chest [Daily] (4.54%).
  • Successfully paying off loans through earning money from jobs. Amount of storage cards you receive from paying off loans is based on how much your loan is, The higher the loan, the more cards you receive when it's paid off. The rate of cards to be received is the same for all credits and increases along with the price. One card is received for every $62,500 in credit. More info.
Paying down a loan in full directly via the Pacific Standard Bank will not reward you with Storage Cards, only loans that are paid off automatically through receiving money from jobs will reward you with Storage Cards.

Self Storage Transfer License

A Self Storage Transfer License allows you to transfer items from your Self Storage to any other online user that also owns that storage. If there is a fee for placing items in this storage you will also pay a fee for transferring items. The License lasts for 7 days and costs $5,000,000 (5M).
It can be bought at the Market(Premium/VIP).

Server Repair is a specialized job in which you need to repair different servers inside the facility with the use of server cable, component & controls to get your <a data-p

"strength">strength, mechanic & player exp as well as your money.

Getting Started

1. Go to the Specialized Job marker Specialized Job at the N.O.O.S.E. HQ just North of East Los Santos.

2. Go to the yellow marker at the front doors and enter the Server Facility.

3. Once inside go to the orange job selector circle and select Server Repair.

4. Go to the green circle beside the job selector and buy your server repair supplies. You need these to complete repair jobs and if you plan on doing this job for a while you should purchase a lot. You can also come back to this location and purchase more if you run out.

5. Wait for a call out to appear in the top right area of your screen. The callout details the supplies you will need, as seen in the image below.

6. Go to the location marked on your map as Job (Server Repair) and repair the server. All the server repairs are inside this interior.

7. You will keep receiving callouts until you switch jobs.

To get rid of the callout after already switching the job, simply do M > Stop job.

Note: This is not a roleplay server. You can not force anyone to roleplay, but if you have consenting RP’ers, you are allowed to within your party so long as it does not interfere with other players.

Rules List

Number

A. - GENERAL RULES

1

Do NOT ram into or kill other players or their vehicles. Vehicle Deathmatching (VDM) is strictly prohibited.

2

Do NOT steal other players' vehicles.

3

Do NOT harass other players or in general interfere with their gameplay. This includes stalking/following or repeatedly buzzing them with an aircraft if they ask you to stop.

4

Do NOT cheat or abuse bugs. This includes client side modifications[*1], exploiting small loopholes, mod menus, gameplay macros, or any other method to progress faster than normal.

5

Do NOT use any racial, homophobic, or any otherwise hateful language and slurs. (Applies to Text Chat and Ingame Voice Chat - Failure to follow this rule will result in severe actions against those who are hateful.)

6

Do NOT use words, similarly spelt words, terms or phrases that could be considered as derogatory or offensive. (Applies to Text Chat and Ingame Voice Chat - Failure to follow this rule may result in severe actions against the player.)

7

Do NOT use coloured text for names.

8

Do Not Buy or Sell in-game items/currency with real world currency, doing so will result in BOTH the Seller AND Buyer being BANNED from our server forever. It breaks FiveM TOS.

9

Always respect other players and staff members.

10

Always report rule breakers to staff either with the report function or in Discord. Not promptly reporting rule breakers you discover could result in punishment for assisting or participating.

11

Always follow and comply with a staff member’s instructions if they ask you to do something or refrain from doing something.

12

Always be aware and respectful of the space around you to avoid collisions or interfering with other players gameplay.

13

Always report any bug(s) you find by pressing M, navigating to Staff Panel and selecting “Report a Bug”.

14

Always refer to the F7 guide before asking for help. This guide is extremely helpful and is made for your convenience!

B. - CHAT RULES

1

Do NOT spam chats.

2

Do NOT argue in chat. If you are having anything more than a civil disagreement with another user, take it to direct messages.

3

Do NOT use overly sexual and inappropriate language or have conversations of sexually charged nature in chat. Always keep jokes respectful and respect other players boundaries regarding what makes them comfortable.

4

Always speak English in chat. Speaking in other languages will get you warned or possibly kicked from the server.
Additionally, in-game advertisements must be in English, or they will be overridden.

5

For Company or Faction chat, the language rule doesn't apply. So any language rules set by respective group can be followed in these specific chats.

C. - FLYING RULES

1

Do NOT spawn or taxi any non-VTOL planes outside the airport.

2

Do NOT takeoff or land an aircraft outside of airports. This includes roads, buildings, and purposely crashing or despawning your plane mid-air to get somewhere faster. You may land helicopters and VTOL anywhere you like as long as it does not block other players; Likewise, you may land seaplanes on water.

3

Do NOT fly HEAVY or aircraft over airline pilot level 30 or cargo pilot level 5 between any buildings. Lower level and leisure aircraft may fly between buildings at the pilots risk, any collision or crash will be at the fault of the pilot and considered ATC failure. This rule does not apply to helicopters.

Lastly and most importantly,

Always have fun, I am sure you will enjoy our server! (Not having fun can be a bannable offense!)

If you see another player not following these server rules you can report them by pressing M then navigating to the “Staff Panel” and pressing “Report a Player”. Please select the player you wish to report and tell us what rule they are breaking.

*1 - Client Side Modifications
  • Anything that changes the shape/size/form of any object/ped/vehicle, is not allowed.
  • Floating objects/structures, changing of the vehicle handling, map modifications are not allowed as it can boost your progress over other players. (exploiting)
  • Everything visual, what only changes the aesthetics of the building/ped/vehicle/object, is allowed.
  • Graphical mods are fine as long as they don't make any of the objects around the map invisible.

(Most of the popular graphics mods add various small objects, usually to vegetation or to the buildings to improve the overall graphical experience, this type of mod is allowed.)

FiveM ToS: https://runtime.fivem.net/platform-license-agreement-12-sept-2023.pdf

Getting Started

  1. Go to one of the 3 snowplow spawn points marked with icon on your map.
    1. The first and closest to city waypoint is near los santos airport.
    2. The next spawn point is near the trucking filtering facility.
    3. The last spawn point is in Paleto bay.
  2. Exit your vehicle and walk into the yellow circle to spawn a Snowplow.
  3. Enable salting by pressing the E key.
  4. Start driving around and cover as much fresh roads as you can.
  5. When you are out of salt, go to any of the Salt Refill stations marked with on the map to refill.

More Information

  • As you drive around, be sure not to drive over the same spot again in a row since it has to "refill" with snow.
    • We recommend taking the highway since it provides a direct loop around the map.
  • You will collect Snowplowing Tokens: as you drive around. These tokens can subsequently be used to purchase new items at a limited-time store located at City Hall.

Overview

Speed Traps are cameras located around the map placed either by the server or Factions. the money you are charged after activating a Speed Trap placed by a Faction will go towards that Factions balance.

Avoidance

There are 4 ways to avoid paying the Speed Trap:

  1. Buy the Speed Trap EMP on the webshop. this will permanently prevent you from being charged by Speed Traps.
  2. Buy Speed Trap Cards from the in-game Traffic Permit Market or loot some out of Medium Grade Chests. These will cost $120 each, they are automatically consumed as one-time-use cards.
  3. Buy a Speed Trap Radar from the Marketplace or loot one out of a High Grade Chests. The Speed Trap Radar will NOT prevent you from being charged, however it will alert you of cameras around you.
  4. Going at or below 64 MPH will ensure no Speed Traps will trigger, thus not receiving any fines. This however isn't recommended as this can severely hinder your efficiency.

Strategy

Speed Traps charge more based on speed and your Player level. When you are relatively new this means the fines should be below $120. In this case it would not be worth it to invest in Speed Trap Cards. Once your fines are regularly above $120, it would be wise to start investing in these cards in bulk.

About

Stormm is a Transport Tycoon staff member and is the Community Director of the server. He is the 4th Community Director of the server, and has been since January 9th, 2023, following DetectiveFabian stepping down. Joining Transport Tycoon in February 2018, Stormm was previously the Head Adminstrator from 2021-2023, Moderator from 2018-2021, and Support from June-September 2018. Outside of the Staff Team, he was also the Co-CEO of Imperial Airlines from 2020-2022, contributed heavily to the original Tycoon Wiki, and is responsible for several of the in-game Transport Tycoon themed vehicle liveries.

Server Work

As the Community Director, Stormm is responsible for managing the Staff Team and situations within the whole community. New staff members are all selected and interviewed by the Community Director as they proceed into the staff team. The Community Director is one of the three head staff roles, in between Server Owner and Head Administrator, and when there is no Head Administrator the Community Director assumes the responsibilities of both roles.

As a vehicle artist he has made liveries for Imperial Airlines, CollinsCo, F.R. LLC, Rockwell Corp, Airline Pilot (Miljet,Q400,787,A330,Concorde), Cargo Pilot (A350), PostOp (JU-52,EMB-390,P3), and several other smaller projects.

Personal

Stormm is a 22 year old student currently studying Film and is a semi-professional photographer. Previously studying business, Stormm holds a diploma in Management.

pages.h:
The revamped streak system, introduced on 8 May 2025. It allows players to earn more Experience or other rewards the higher their streak is.

Streaks reset after the clock goes past 00:00 UTC three times and you did not complete at least one objective/delivery, so for example:

You complete a EMS mission at 11:00 pm UTC, there is 1 hour left until midnight, then another 48'' until it is midnight UTC for the second time, meaning you only have a total of49 hours'' to keep your streak.

Jobs that already benefit from the streak system:

EMS

As you deliver patients to the hospital, you build up a streak. At every drop off you earn more Experience and EXP Tokens for every patient dropped off. Below is a picture of a graph of how EMS XP (Ground), EMS XP (Helicopter), Heli XP (Helicopter) and Mobile ER (EMS XP) scales up after each drop off.

Firefighter

There are no set streak thresholds, the exp earned is dependent on 3 variables. The region in which you have completed the call-out (tier, this can be a number between 1 and 6 and always is 6 at level 100+), the difficulty of a fire (difficulty, this is a random number between 1 and 5) and your streak (with a maximum of 1000).

This also applies to the amount of money you get, but this gets calculated through a different formula. The amount of BXP items you get is calculated by the raw exp formula.

The formula for raw exp: (tier * 5 + 7 + difficulty) * (1 + 0.2 * ((streak - 1) / 100) ^ 1.5)

The formula for money: (tier + difficulty + (streak / 10)) * 5000

RTS

As you complete RTS deliveries, you increase your streak by 1, this will increase the amount of exp you gain per delivery.

The streak increases rewards linearly and starts at 7.5 EXP and 30 000$. The RTS streak has currently no maximum.

The increase is +0.075 EXP and 300$ per delivery

(This is not yet formally confirmed, but the result of the communities testing)

Cabbie

As you complete Cabbie callouts, you increase your streak by 1, this will increase the amount of exp you gain per dropoff.

The Cabbies streak starts at 6 exp. The exp for a dropoff is dependent on the distance of the delivery, the current streak and if you manage to deliver in time.

The formula for raw exp: (distance) * ((100 + streak)/100) * (time bonus)

Where distance can have the value 6 exp for deliveries that are less than 3500m away and 7.5 exp for ones that are further away and the time bonus is a *2 Multiplier if you manage to deliver in time.

P.I.G.S Robberrery

xpBase = 10 * tier

The Train conductor streak uses a logarithm and increase less as the streak increase

Airline Pilot

Per Deboarding you will receive an additional 1% xp bonus which stacks after every stop.

Helicopter Pilot

Per Full Route completed you will receive an additional 1% xp bonus which stacks after every stop.

HUD


The progress of your current streak can be seen in this tab under identity in your M menu.

If one number is visible it shows your current streak and highest streak in one. If two numbers are shown, the one on the left is your current streak and the one on the right was your highest streak.

Trivia

  • Login Chat Titles are rewarded for logging in to the Transport Tycoon Server for a certain amount of total days. Previously this needed to be consecutive days.
  • With the old streak system, where rewards also increased the more objectives/deliveries were completed in one session, your streak used to reset back to 0 when leaving or reconnecting.

pages.h:
Being stuck is an unfortunate given in this economy. Being stuck means you are not being efficient. Efficiency is key in the world of Transport Tycoon.

Ideally, you'd want to become unstuck. Getting unstuck is of the highest priority.

Listed below are several scenarios and their possible solutions.

Stuck on Foot

If you managed to get stuck on foot, lodged in an object for example, your best bet is to relog. Upon relogging, you will be given a list of possible locations to teleport to. If you don't have any teleports unlocked, you will have to make a staff ticket and request to be moved. This can be done by typing /report, followed by your message. For example: /report I am stuck between a rock and a hard place, can someone please help me out of my misery?

Stuck in the Middle of the Ocean

The ocean is vast and scary. Despite this, escaping the ocean is quite simple. The server will automatically respawn you on land if you manage to drown. It might sound morbid, but go ahead and taste the salty depths of the ocean. Before you know it, your feet will be touching land.

If instead you want to create an impromptu adventure out of this scenario, you could also spawn a jetski (B→Spawn Jet Ski) and sail the seven seas to land. Don't pretend you've discovered new land though, you're not a navigator!

Stuck in a vehicle

Vehicle is Stuck on an Object

If your vehicle is stuck on an object, try to lift the hydraulics. Hold LeftAlt, press the right mouse button and find the 'Lift Hydraulics' sphere. Once the sphere is pink, try moving back and forth and wiggle to either side. Eventually the wheels will pop up, giving you more vertical space to wiggle yourself free of this doom scenario.

Vehicle is Upside Down

If your vehicle is upside down, you should see a prompt appear in the bottom right, telling you what key to press to flip over the car. In the unfortunate case you have already exited the vehicle, your only hope is to attempt to flip it over by colliding into it with another vehicle. If that is not a possibility, you'll have to Autopark/Zdelete the vehicle and respawn it at an appropriate Garage once more.

pages.h:
Transport Tycoon has a web store, where benefits can be bought in exchange for real life currency.

It can be accessed by typing /shop in-game, or by navigating to the Transport Tycoon web store.

Listed below are all options available on the web store. Refer to the web store for up-to-date information.

In-Game

Bonuses

Double EXP Ticket

This bonus is only available on your current server. Once the party starts, it will remain active on that server. In the event of another Double EXP Party being active, yours will be queued up and is started once the previous Party or Parties has finished.

reminder

The Double EXP Ticket allows you to start a Double Experience Party on your server that will last for 30 minutes!

Everyone gains 100% more base experience while the party is active.

Treasure Master Key

A reusable item that allows you to open an indefinite amount of Treasure Chests. It can not be traded or trashed.

Mechanic Toolbox

A consumable item which grants additional Mechanic EXP by 50% for 1 hour.

Extra Business Stack

Permanently increases your businesses' maximum collection limit by 1. (16 by default)

By default, your businesses will collect revenue for up to 48 hours (2 days / 16 cycles).

TL;DR: Allows your businesses to collect revenue for another 3 hours (per purchase). Each cycle is 3 hours, meaning 8 cycles will occur every real day.

Extra Business Day

Permanently increases your businesses' maximum collection limit by 8. (16 by default)

By default, your businesses will collect revenue for up to 48 hours (2 days / 16 cycles).

Each cycle is 3 hours, meaning 8 cycles will occur every real day.

TL;DR: Allows your businesses to collect revenue for another 24 hours (per purchase)

Customizations

Re-name Faction

You need to be the Faction President of the <a data-p

"Faction">Faction you are currently in!

reminder

Normal rules for Faction name and tag applies. We will not provide refunds.

Custom License Plate

Customize the license plate on your vehicle!

Restrictions:

  • Must be 8 symbols
  • Space, Letters and numbers only

Upgrades

Speed Trap EMP

Nearby Speed Traps are disabled, meaning you will never be caught again.

Pre-paid Autopass

Using a pre-paid autopass means you will pass any Toll Plaza for free, regardless of what car you are driving.

Instant Respawn

Dying in water will always put you back on land.

reminder

You no longer need Pills to re-spawn where you died. The fade-out effect when re-spawning will no longer occur.

This perk replaces the existing "No hunger / thirst" perk

Old description: Completely disable the need to eat and drink!

Fuel System

Quality of life changes to the fuel system.

You can upgrade to Disable Fuel System at a discounted rate if you already own Free Fuel

Free Fuel

No longer pay for fuel, you can refuel for free!

Disable fuel system

Disable the need to maintain fuel in your vehicle.

Other

Captain's Hour

Items in this category help fund and support the Captain's Hour show in Discord.

The show is held by TheCaptain in our Discord at 10PM EST when possible.

Any purchase made from this category will be announced in the Captain's Hour text channel.

Captain's Hour Title

Show your love for Captain's Hour with this in-game chat title!

Your purchase is shown in the Captain's Hour discord channel!

Captain's Hour Chat Prefix Icon

Show your love for Captain's Hour with this in-game chat prefix icon!

Your purchase is shown in the Captain's Hour discord channel!

Captain's Hour Playerlist Title

Show your love for Captain's Hour with this player list title!

Your purchase is shown in the Captain's Hour discord channel!

Access

Beta Server access

Allows access to the Beta servers.

Beta servers receive early updates.

You need to join a server to receive this reward.

reminder

Gift Cards

Pay-what-you-want

You decide how much to pay. A direct payment option, there are no perks or rewards given by this package.

You may specify a custom amount to pay, and a note for what the purchase is for.

This option can be used for non-standard payment.

Gift Card

A Gift Card you can share with a friend, it can be used during checkout in the web store.

The Gift Card code will be sent to your email after checkout.

Frequently Asked Questions

Questions repeatedly asked by the community, compiled for an easier time!

Are Business Stacks / Days permanent or one-time?

Business Stacks permanently increases your business' collection limit by 1 each. Meaning your businesses will collect revenue for an extra 3 hours before they must be collected. (Defaults to 16 stacks, or 48 hours)

Business Days do the exact same, but adds 8 each instead of just one.

When does the Double EXP Party start?

Double EXP Parties start instantly when the Double EXP Ticket is used in-game. It can be started at any time.

If you have any questions regarding the purchases, you can ask in our Discord

pages.h:
Welcome to the technical FAQ

this FAQ answers your simple technical questions and tries to resolve issues as fast as possible.

For more generally Frequently Asked Questions, visit FAQ

Missing Icons/Blips

That "error" can happen through a loading error or just a setting. Otherwise it could also be that you just didn't Discovered that Blip yet as we got a Discovery Script which only show the Blip when you were there at least once.

If you don't see any Blips at all then it's an error and you can resolve it with a simple Reconnect. if the reconnect didn't resolve the issue, then please move to the Clear Cache section and try to clear your cache.

If you just see a Couple Blips like Garages, Fuel Points and unbought Businesses Then open your M Menu, go into Player Options and then into Interface options. Search the Toggle Map Blips Option and press it Two times

If you just see a Couple Blips , Fuel Points, Traffic Permit markets and Pills Then open your M Menu, go into Player Options and then into Interface options. Search the Toggle Map Blips Option and press it One time

In the end the Map should look like this:

Map is glitching out

Transport Tycoon displays a lot more blips than was originally intended for Grand Theft Auto V. This causes the map to malfunction at times.

Wrong blip is being selected/Can not select blips/Can not move the map

To temporarily fix this issue, switch to a different menu tab with Q or E, let that new tab load in and then go back to the Map. You should now be able to interact with the map correctly again.

Waypoint is being placed somewhere else

See temporary fix above. Alternatively you can place a Point Of Interest (TAB by default). You can then place your waypoint on the POI. POI's do not save between sessions.

Map Legend is flickering

This is due to hitting a hard limit of blip types. To fix this issue you will need to hide some blips. To do this, type /blip, select Hidden Blips and hide blips you do not use.

Clear Cache

So you want to know how to clear your cache as you encounter a crash on the server and/or cant join anymore?

1. Press WIN+R
2. Type in "%localappdata%\FiveM\FiveM.app" or "%localappdata%\FiveM" dependant on when you installed FiveM
3. You are now in your Application Folder where you want to delete the file "cache.xml"
4. Now as you deleted that file try to join one of the servers
5. If that didn't help then go back to Step 1 and continue after that with step 6.
6. So the 3rd step didn't work then now as you are again in the Application folder go also into the Cache folder.
7. After the re-verification try to join the server again.
8. If that also didn't work go back into the cache folder and also delete the server's folder.
8.1 This will delete all server files you have downloaded and need to re-download them when you join the Server.
9. When Step 8, 8.1 don't work you want to delete the Game folder (this will re-verify the game files)

Steam authentication failed: Http 429

Note: This method will only work if you have other active identifiers linked to your account.

To fix this you need to close steam: Go to the top left of the screen Steam > Exit or use task manager to close the steam bootstrapper. Once steam has fully closed. Launch FiveM and join the server. After you have loaded into the server you are free to open steam again.

yaml-cpp: error at line x, column xx: illegal EOF in scalar

That error is an common FiveM error the only fix from our side would be to just retry to join the server. It could take up to 40 retries.

Otherwise, you could also just press enter and it should connect right away

Failed to GetInfo server after 3 attempts

This is a common FiveM error. Try connecting through http://connect.tycoon.community, http://ttstats.eu, or press F8 and type: connect 2epova (main server) or connect njyvop (beta server) .

Airports are not loading in

This is a common issue with FiveM Streaming Maps that we use for the Airports. To fix this please go to Esc -> Settings -> Advanced Graphics -> High Detail Streaming While Flying> On

This will fix the issues of airports not loading in whilst flying!

Falling through the ground? World textures start to disappear? Buildings looking like mush?

Try highering the Extended Texture Budget bit by bit until the issue stops.
Do not max out this setting all at once as this can worsen the situation and can cause other issues:

Esc -> Settings -> Graphics -> Extended Texture Budget

Set your texture quality to normal:

Esc -> Settings -> Graphics -> Texture Quality -> Normal

In Transport Tycoon, there are only a few ways to teleport/warp around the map.

Joining Game

When joining the game, a menu will pop up. This menu is an aggregate of all your unlocked Business, House, Faction and Company teleports. It will only appear once upon logging in.

Businesses

Several Businesses offer a Spawn Point perk, unlocked after levelling up the business to at least level 2.

Owned House

If you own a House, you can teleport to it through this way as well.

Train Station Warps

At several points on the train tracks you can find train stations, which can be used to get across the map quickly by using the warps.

On this page you can read all about EXP Tokens and their uses. They were previously known as Vouchers.

EXP Token

When doing certain jobs, you earn EXP Tokens. Each EXP Token is worth 0.1 experience in its skill. (see below)

The EXP Token cannot be traded with other players. To do this, you need to convert it to Bonus EXP first.

Each EXP Token can be converted to a Bonus EXP item. In order to convert all at once, you can press the left arrow when the convert option is highlighted.

Bonus EXP

When the "Bonus EXP" item is in your inventory, you will gain additional experience every time you normally gain experience. Each Bonus EXP item is equivalent to 0.1 experience. For every 0.1 experience you gain, a Bonus EXP item is consumed and you gain an additional 0.1 experience. This effect goes up to 100.0 experience at a time. (Meaning up to 1000 Bonus EXP items can be consumed at once)

The Bonus EXP item can be put on the marketplace, allowing you to effectively sell the EXP Tokens you receive.

Cargo Pilot Perk

With the Cargo Pilot Perk, you can obtain large amounts of Bonus EXP quickly. With the Perk active, you will no longer receive any EXP, and 50% of that sacrificed EXP is turned into EXP Bonus instead. This is useful for players looking to earn money by selling Bonus EXP via player to player trading, or by selling through the Marketplace.

Removal of Vouchers

Bonus EXP and EXP Tokens were previously known as Skill Vouchers.
Vouchers discouraged players from doing jobs, allowing them to complete many jobs by simply paying their way out of it. Never once setting foot in a job vehicle.

  • EXP Tokens still keep the benefit of "paying for experience".
  • EXP Tokens keeps trading healthy (with the Bonus EXP item).
  • Players now have the ability to get boosted EXP yields without having to sit idle for hours at the Grand Exchange.
  • You still maintain the player trade profit aspect from the Vouchers.

Converting old Vouchers

If you've ended up with Skill Vouchers in your inventory and don't know what to do with them, they can be converted to the new system. Simply put them into any kind of external storage (for example a vehicle trunk or self storage) and then take them back out.

Train Conductors Train emoji transport passengers around the map by rail. There are two different metro lines, one passenger train line and one freight train line available. As a level 1 Conductor, you will start with Metro and are then able to unlock Freight and Passenger Trains later on.

Metro / Subway Tram

  • Head to any Job Center Job Center job center (except for LifeInvader) and select the Train Conductor job. The smallest tier Metro requires level 1 conductor, which is what you start with.
  • Find one of the red metro train icons on the map, Metro Train located at LSIA or Davis street, then find the marker and press the indicated button to open the metro spawn menu.
  • Select a Metro train tier you can use.
  • Drive forward until the job prompt begins.
  • Drive your metro to all the stops indicated on your map Passenger Stop to complete the route.
  • You will earn Train Conductor Experience and Experience Tokens from each stop and for completing your route.
    • If your Train Conductor level is 100 or higher, you will instead receive extra Experience Tokens but no more regular Experience from Metro.

Transformer Repair is a specialized job in which you need to repair broken Transformers with the use of different Fuses, Relays & Cables to receive <a data-p

Getting Started

1. Go to the Specialized Job marker Specialized Job in the Northeast area of Los Santos.

2. Go to the orange Job Selector circle and choose Transformer Repair.

3. Go to the green market icon and purchase Cables, Fuses, and Relays. You need these to complete repair jobs and if you plan on doing this job for a while you should purchase a lot. You can also come back to this location and purchase more when you run out.

4. Wait for a call out to appear in the top right area of your screen, the call out details the supplies you will need, as seen in this image below.

5. Go to the location marked on your map as Job (Transformer Repair) and repair the transformer.

  • You will keep receiving callouts until you switch jobs.
  • The Sparrow helicopter can be used for this job. It has a capacity of 1,000 KG ( 1,150 with Tycoon Premium).

To get rid of the callout after already switching to another job, simply press M > Stop job.

Treasure Chests Treasure are chests that spawn individually whenever someone levels up in a skill. They can also randomly spawn in bulk. The chests can easily be found because of their icon on the map and their high-rising yellow beam.

Ways to obtain Treasure Chests

While Treasure Chests are obtained simply by passing through the high-rising yellow beam, there are other ways to obtain them too and are listed below:

  • Beach Cleaning will give you Trash as a sub-product which can be saved up to create low/medium/high and ultra-grade Treasure chests at the Recycling Plant Recycling Plant up North in Sandy Shores.
  • Low and Medium-grade Chests can also be obtained by donating to the Fountain of Wealth. $50k for low-grade chest & $250k for medium-grade chest.
  • Exclusively, Ultra-grade Treasure Chest can be purchased from the Market(Premium/VIP) for 10 Skill Level Tokens.
  • Can also be purchased from the Marketplace or traded with other players.

Treasure Key

To open a treasure chest, one will need a Treasure Key, which is consumed when you open the chest. These keys can be found from the same high-rising yellow beams or:

  • Received via breaking down a medium, high or ultra grade chest.
  • Prospecting (Legendary 0.09%) (Rare 0.5%).
  • Open Treasure Chest [Low-grade] (5.55%).
  • Buying it from a player or Marketplace.

If you have a treasure key and a treasure chest, go to M → Inventory → Your chest → Open to open the treasure chest.

After interacting with the chest, it will grant an item (see treasure contents below) and will subsequently apply a cooldown of a few seconds to prevent people from farming chests too rapidly.

Daily Chests

A Treasure Chest [Daily] can be obtained automatically when you log in to the server every day.

  • There's also a 4.54% chance a Treasure Chest [Daily] contains another Daily Chest when opened.

Rewards

  • High grade treasure
  • Medium grade treasure
  • Low grade treasure
  • Treasure keys

All items can be sold on the Marketplace

TruckersTrucking emoji are the backbone of Transport Tycoon. We’ve developed a complex web of cargo materials that allow you to simply sell one at a time, or collect and combine cargoes in multi-point routes for maximum profit!

Be sure to ask around for helpful guides developed by the community. Oh, and we also have a custom radio station! We offer TruckersFM,Simulator Radio and UpBeat Radio available in the left-bottom-center area of the radio wheel.

Getting started

If this is your first time trucking, it's recommended to read the <a data-p

"Getting Started Guide">Getting Started Guide for essential basic information about usage of the vehicle trunk/storage and trucking in general.
  • Head to the Job Center Job Center job center and select the Trucker job.
  • Visit the Car Dealership Car Dealer car dealershop to purchase the Speedo Express or a combination of a semi-cab (truck) and trailer.
    • The Speedo Express is free and has a trunk capacity equal to your own inventory capacity from 30kg to 300kg.
  • Click on Getting Started Guide for First time truckers.

Vehicles

Trucking requires a semi-cab (truck) and trailer to store cargo in. Semi-cabs can be bought from a car dealership Car Dealer car dealershopor alternatively Semi Spawners can be spawned at a few locations around the map. Examples include LSIA, Sandy Shores, and LS Docks. Players that are short on cash can begin with the free Speedo Express. The trunk capacity of the Speedo scales with the players' Strength level.

Basic Commercial Routes

You start a trucking route by picking up cargo from one of the following cargo sellers. Go to the cargo seller to obtain your cargo, load as much as you can in your vehicle and then head to a Cargo Buyer that accepts the cargo to sell it. Logs, Recycled Trash, Toxic Waste, Recycled Electronics and Quarry Rubble are all part of more in-depth commercial trucking routes. Make sure to have a look at the Advanced Cargo Routes section.

Logging

Logging is unlocked at level 6, this is the first type of trucking where there are multiple steps in the process. You want to:

  • Pick up Logs from the Logging Camp.
  • Take the Logs to the Sawmill to turn them into Sawdust or Planks.
    • Both the Sawdust and the Planks can be sold at the LS Port Export or stored in Self Storages to be combined with other items.

Recycled Materials Base Process

At level 9 you will unlock Recycled Trash, this can be picked up from the Recycling Center. You want to:

  • Take the Recycled Trash to the Sorting Facility to obtain three materials from it:
    • Scrap Plastic can be exported from the McKenzie Export.
    • Scrap Aluminum and Scrap Tin can be refined at the LS Foundry.
      • Refined Aluminum and Refined Tin are exported from the LS Port Export.

From here, the process will evolve allowing more materials and new combinations of materials. The more steps the process has, the more you will earn from it. Item descriptions and exploration of the different locations should lead you on to new processes.

If you are looking for a trucking alternative/enrichment and want to earn some Trucking BXP, check out the partnered server: LITE Transportation

FAQs

How do I detach my trailer?

You can detach your Trailer by holding the H key. To re-attach your Trailer, press the H key when prompted, your Trailer will snap to the same orientation your Truck is facing.

How Can I customise my MK10-13

  1. Park your Trailer over LS Customs
  2. Detach your Trailer from your Truck
  3. Move your Truck away from LS Customs
  4. Head to the side over your trailer and press F to 'drive' the trailer
  5. Now use the Enter Key to enter LS Customs

How can I customise my MK14?

  1. Park your Trailer over LS Customs
  2. Detach your Trailer from your Truck
  3. Move your Truck away from LS Customs
  4. Go back to your Trailer and open your Trunk (see Getting Started Guide)
  5. The Trailer door will now be open, go into the back of your Trailer and press F to 'drive' the Trailer
  6. Now use the Enter key to enter LS Customs

What is Tycoon Gaming?

As a community, we currently focus mainly on Transport Tycoon on the FiveM platform.

Transport Tycoon puts you into the vast world of San Andreas, where your goal is to build yourself up to the status of multi-millionaire (or even billionaire!). By working hard in several unique jobs you will eventually gain new equipment and unlock new features that will aid you in an even faster way to the top!

Experience the skies of San Andreas & Cayo Perico while you're transporting passengers or cargo via planes. Travel thousands of kilometers on the endless network of roads in your own truck while trying to navigate your logistics route. Or take a break, sit down at the pier, and fish while you watch the sunset on the horizon. Plus several other jobs and activities to experience on the Transport Tycoon servers.

Tycoon Premium is an account license that offers multiple bonuses and perks.

How do I get Tycoon Premium?

Tycoon Premium can be obtained in multiple ways:

  • Purchase it at the City Hall for $50,000,000 (50 Million) or with 100 Skill Level Tokens
  • Rewarded to $25 or $50 Patreon Patrons as a benefit for as long as the membership lasts.

You will receive a Premium Package when you buy it.
To find and use the package go to your inventory (M -> Inventory) and select the Premium Package
Once used, your tycoon premium will immediately activate.

Once the Premium Package has been used, it cannot be traded anymore.

info

How long does the Premium license last?

Tycoon Premium lasts 30 days from the time of activation. If you activate a new premium license during that time, it will not extend the existing duration, but will start the 30 days over again. For Patreon, Premium will last for as long as the membership lasts.

Tycoon Premium perks

As a Premium member you will receive the following perks:

  • Access to Premium Vehicles.
  • A Global 15% inventory size increase. This includes player inventory, vehicle trunks and storage units.
  • A star next to your name in chat. (Activate in M -> Player Options -> Chat Appearance)
  • A special title and icon in the player list. (Activate in M -> Player Options -> Chat Appearance)
  • Access to Premium Trucking Routes.
  • Access to the "Take to Trunk" and "Dump Trunk" option in storage units.

Troubleshooting

If for some reason you do not receive a Premium Package when purchasing, relog immediately. Upon relogging, you should now properly see the package in your inventory

Trivia

  • Premium used to also give a global 50% Experience increase, this was removed with the fresh start.

Data Collection

Account Information: We collect usernames and passwords solely for the purpose of creating and managing user accounts. No email or additional personal identifying information is required. User Contributions: Contributions to the wiki are publicly visible and associated with the user's account.

Use of Information

The information we collect is used exclusively for account management and user authentication. We do not use this information for marketing or any other purposes.

Data Sharing and Disclosure

Personal information is not shared with third parties, except as required by law. User contributions are publicly accessible and may be used by other users.

Cookies and Tracking

The Tycoon Gaming Wiki uses cookies as part of the MediaWiki software. These cookies are essential for website functions such as user session management. Data Retention

We store collected data indefinitely, as long as the server hosting the data remains operational. Users can request the deletion of their account and associated data by contacting us.

1. ff0000 #ffe0e0 #000000 24px Upgrade Kits Information #000000 16px Some of the Upgrade kits remain disabled, but others work, Most of the cash Upgrades no longer work apart from the Hauler and Hauler Custom Upgrade.

Upgrade kits allow you to upgrade or alter a vehicle via certain locations around the map! There are a few ways to obtain upgrade kit chests. All information is below.

Ways to obtain upgrade kits

  1. Prospecting - This is the most common way of receiving an upgrade kit, however, the chance of getting one is low. (Don't expect to get one quickly, may take hours or days depending on your luck.)
  2. Daily Chests - This is another way of getting an upgrade kit, having a much lower chance of receiving it. (Daily Chests are obtained automatically when you log in to the server every day.
  3. Marketplace - This is the easiest way to obtain upgrade kits. (Can only be done via marketplace and not player to player trading as upgrade kits are untradeable! )

There are also multiple locations where vehicles can be upgraded. These locations vary, depending on the type. (e.g sport/super etc) If you are in a vehicle that's able to upgrade, a blip on your in-game map will appear showing you the upgrade station location.

NOT ALL VEHICLES REQUIRE A KIT TO UPGRADE! SOME HAVE DIFFERENT REQUIREMENTS SUCH AS MONEY OR SPACESHIP PARTS!

All Upgradable Vehicles

There are a handful of vehicles that can only be obtained through upgrading another vehicle. Vehicle can require both an upgrade kit and money to upgrade. A vehicle shipment indicates the original vehicle can only be made or obtained from Vehicle Shipments. After upgrading, some vehicles can be upgraded again to an even better vehicle.

User Applications are web applications loaded directly into the game client.

Note: This application will get access to game and account information, only load applications you trust.

By pressing F1 and entering a URL into the input field, you will load the web application at the specified URL inside your game client.

The game will provide details about you (the player), your game (what you're doing) and your account (progress, job, account information) directly to the web application.

This web application will be able to display information on your screen, and it can have an interactable interface accessible using the F1 key.

There are 4 optional keys you can set in the FiveM section of the Keyboard Bindings in the game settings:

Square, Triangle, Circle and Cross. These 4 buttons may interact with the web application, if it supports their use.

For developers who want to create user applications, see http://server.tycoon.community:30125/status/config/user-apps or for a html rendered version see https://ttycoon.eu/userapps/docs

For users who want to find a list of public user applications, see the user-applications channel (Discord)

Vehicle Boost is a vehicle modification that can be applied to vehicles which can increase the top speed of your vehicle. It is served as a temporary speed boost to vehicles until the vehicle is despawned. There are currently 10%, 15%, 25% and 30% vehicle boosts available for vehicles.




Obtaining

To use Vehicle Boost, your vehicle must have Turbo installed. This can be done in LS Customs

info

Multiple methods in which you can apply a Vehicle Boost to your vehicle are as follows:

Faction

  • Certain Factions offer temporary Vehicle Boosts (Vehicle Boost Vendor) Vehicle Booster as a Faction Perk, which can be purchased by the Faction President and Faction Officers, offering 15% or 25% Boost at the cost of $150.00k & $250.00k respectively when applied to vehicles (per use).
  • Alternatively, Garage Speed Boost Faction Perk automatically applies a free 10% boost to your vehicle when the vehicle is spawned within the Faction Garage.

On the Map

  • 15% Vehicle Booster variants can also be found in 3 different locations around the map. The cost per use is $150.00k.

See pictures below for their locations:

Vehicle Booster (1/3)
Los Santos, Richman Hills

Vehicle Booster (2/3)
Grand Senora Desert

Vehicle Booster (3/3)
Benny's garage in Los Santos

Racing Perk

  • The last and currently highest boost available is 30%, which is applied via obtaining and enabling the Racing Perk. This type of boost can be enabled/disabled from the perks list on your character's Phone. When enabled, it auto-applies to all owned vehicles that are spawned from a garage.

Information

  • While other Vehicle boosters can be used to boost both you and other player's vehicles, the 30% boost type is only applied upon spawning your owned vehicle and can not be applied to other players if they don't own the racing perk.
  • Vehicle boosts can also be applied to Planes, allowing a slight boost while taxiing. however, this makes it harder to navigate and steer in the process while offering no actual boost in the air.
  • Starting a race in a boosted vehicle will automatically remove the percentage of the boost at the beginning of the race.

Trivia

  • Staff Vehicles can have a 50% speed boost.
    • Admins and above can add a custom boost amount.
  • During events (in the event server), all player vehicles can be boosted (simultaneously) far beyond 50% by staff members.

pages.h:
Vehicles can be bought at a Car Dealer vehicle shop, which then become available for spawning at a garage. Vehicles require fuel to run, and the top speed of a vehicle may be different from vanilla cars. They can be found in Central LS (Simeon's car dealership), Sandy Shores, Paleto Bay, Cayo Perico and possibly at your faction. Owned vehicles can be sold to other players using a Shipping Container.

The availability of vehicles to purchase rotates each day. Once a vehicle becomes available it can be bought from the store for a few days. This means that if you are looking for a specific vehicle and it is not visible in the vehicle shop, you may need to wait a few days for it to become available. pages.h:
Rules

Normal Rules:

  1. Do not vandalize.
  2. Do not remove chunks of information unless you need to.
  3. Refrain from revealing hidden and secret content as this ruins the secret element.

Translator Rules:

  1. Only edit protected pages to add translations.
  2. The Rule above does not apply to Transport Tycoon Staff, who are allowed to edit those pages.
  3. You are allowed to add/remove yourself in the Translator Section on the Credits page.

Guidelines

  1. Information should not include personal opinions
    1. Direct information must be provided
    2. Do not include any bias
  2. Use page links as often as possible, it's easier for everyone that way.

How to contribute

The default theme/"skin" hides most editing tools for a clean user-interface. For easier access, switch to the editor theme:

  1. Go to Preferences
  2. Under Appearance, select the Editor skin
  3. Save changes

Translator Tutorial

For all currently available languages, please see this!
=== Page Creation === In order to translate a page, you have to either go to an existing (e.x not finished) translated page of it, or "create" one:
Simply navigate to https://dash.tycoon.community/wiki/index.php/LANGUAGE_INITIALS:Tycoon_Gaming_Wiki and click "create this page".
Replace `LANGUAGE_INTIALS` with your language's initials. For example, German: DE

warn

Categories

Every language has it's own category of pages that were translated.
Only add to the bottom of your translated Page.

Templates

In order to translate templates, simply put a language tag between the template, and the template name
It should look like this: Template:LANGUAGE_INITIALS:Template_name
to use those in pages, it's quite the same:


A list of templates used in a page can be seen at the bottom of it.

General Editing Stuff

Templates

You'll probably see the following abbreviation a lot of times while editing wiki pages:
The contents inside those brackets make it possible to render a "template"
For example, use to show all purchasable bicycles.
A detailed tutorial about how to edit wiki pages correctly can be found here

More Information

See this page for more information and explanations on how to properly edit, and create pages.
